descriptions.c64:146503: Collect diamonds across 20 single-screen mine shafts, shooting the monsters released from a central pen; dust blocks bullets until it has been walked through.
descriptions.c64:146505: Text adventure tracking down the Sinclive Diamond, taken from Microdrivia's royal Jewel Room in the land of Spectraisia shortly before its public unveiling.
descriptions.c64:146507: Side-scrolling action based on the 1990 Warren Beatty film adaptation of the detective comic, taking Tracy through five stages.
descriptions.c64:146508: Dicky the Owl wins back the diamonds Stephen the Spider stole by wrecking each web the spider spins to show one off.
descriptions.c64:146510: Top-down shooter in the vein of Alien Syndrome: a lone spaceman battles aliens through a space base of doors, transporters and energy barriers, activating terminals scattered around it.
descriptions.c64:146516: After eating a cheese sandwich before bed against his mother's advice, a boy is stuck in a nightmare and must collect the hot milk on each top-down screen to reach her room.
descriptions.c64:146517: Archon-style strategy on a 9x10 board of dinosaurs; moving onto an opponent's square triggers an action duel to decide who wins it.
descriptions.c64:146518: Dinosaur racing on the battle asteroid Delagod in 2127, at the fourth staging of an intergalactic saurian championship. Published in Game On magazine.
descriptions.c64:146519: Platformer guiding a reptile through trap-filled levels, finding keys to open the way to each exit, with music by Jeroen Tel among others.
descriptions.c64:146522: Adaptation of the Diplomacy board game for as many as six players, each a great European power of the early 20th century seeking control of the continent through troop and fleet placement and negotiation.
descriptions.c64:146527: Satirical set of five consecutive games about Charles and Diana having a second baby, from proving their parenting skills through to the birth.
descriptions.c64:146529: Vertical shooter across four levels against waves of enemy craft, with pickups activated by holding fire; Cosmos Designs' first game, from Magic Disk 64.
descriptions.c64:146533: Clear every block from the board against the clock: selecting a cell flips it and its diagonal neighbors, removing filled blocks and filling empty spaces.
descriptions.c64:146534: Text adventure in which a kidnapped diplomat tries to escape, refusing to leave without his briefcase and the evidence against the terrorists.
descriptions.c64:146584: Design and program a cyber-tank within a budget, then pit it against opponents; success brings higher security clearance and more money for better designs.
descriptions.c64:146586: Side-on driving game with a constant scroll, overtaking traffic to cover as many laps as possible; the car starts at 60, and pushing past 100 raises the score.
descriptions.c64:146590: Math shooter: a ship along the bottom fires upward at targets according to arithmetic problems, with a choice of operations such as multiplication or addition.
descriptions.c64:146593: Second When Superpowers Collide wargame, following Germany 1985: Soviet paratroopers seize Middle Eastern oil fields and the U.S. Rapid Deployment Force responds.
descriptions.c64:146596: Straightforward Tetris variant: rotate and shift falling blocks to complete lines, with a split-screen mode for two players.
descriptions.c64:146605: Help Grand Dizzy test his toy machine by sliding a shape bar along the bottom so each falling shape from four descending tubes drops into a matching outline.
descriptions.c64:146606: Dizzy and Daisy, lost in the Enchanted Forest and chased by Rockwart the Troll and his henchtrolls, ride an old apple barrel down the river rapids.
descriptions.c64:146608: Fruit machine simulation: decide whether to bank or gamble winnings, then try a dice round guessing whether the next roll will be higher or lower.
descriptions.c64:146609: Transported to the Wild West by a time machine, shoot down armed gangsters for bounty money without hitting the innocent passersby in the street.
descriptions.c64:146610: An experiment pumped DNA into the player's brain, and after a lab explosion left the professor in a coma, a shrunken navy assault ship is sent into the bloodstream to halt the process.
descriptions.c64:146613: Wargame set in late 1943 in southern Ukraine: hold a thin German defensive line on the Dnieper against computer-controlled Soviet attacks aimed at capturing objectives.
descriptions.c64:146615: A professor's experiment loaded the hero's brain with DNA, then a lab blast put him in a coma; a miniaturized navy gunship travels through the bloodstream to stop the process. Italian release of DNA Warrior.
descriptions.c64:146624: Action take on Fate of Atlantis: Indy and his former student Sophie travel from Monte Carlo onward, mostly in isometric view, collecting the discs that open the lost city.
descriptions.c64:146651: Top-down track racing in the style of Super Sprint, three small cars competing while collecting fuel and avoiding hazards that blow the car up and lose time.
descriptions.c64:146666: Steer a set of four bouncing balls through twelve settings from parks and deserts to beaches and undersea, gathering up to ten balloons per stage while jumping or squashing hazards that pop them.
descriptions.c64:146667: Ned works inside a human head, carrying nerve impulses to the brain and from the brain down to the neck while dodging enemies such as the throbs.
descriptions.c64:146669: Ninja Kage battles the warlord's henchmen with sword and throwing stars through forest, moat and castle stages that repeat with the changing seasons, to rescue Princess Kiri.
descriptions.c64:146670: Sinbad, captured by the wicked Sultan Salabim, must break free and then destroy him across five levels that switch styles between maze, platform, first-person shooting and side-view action.
descriptions.c64:146671: Lead the small-time thief Leonardo through 50 top-down levels of banks, museums and warehouses, shoving objects that slide until they hit something.
descriptions.c64:146673: Puzzle board of spinning wheels: rotate them and send green, purple, blue and yellow balls along connecting paths until each wheel holds four of one color.
descriptions.c64:146674: The evil wizard Erona has opened the gates of Hell, and the last ninja able to stop him must slay him and seal them again. From Golden Disk 64.
descriptions.c64:146675: Defend Earth's last lunar garrison from the Zytron Strike Force: locate the invaders with an infrared detector, cross the moon on the map, then fight them in 3D combat.
descriptions.c64:146676: Platformer based on Silver's Italian comic: across 10 levels Lupo Alberto, or his hen sweetheart, tries to find a quiet place for the couple to be together, with every other character, above all the dog Mose, in the way.
descriptions.c64:146677: Continuing the war on the Seiddab, skim a hovercraft above their moon, destroy the DAB tanks, then weave through a minefield over mountains and a missile range to reach their base.
descriptions.c64:146678: Infocom horror: on a snowbound night at G.U.E. Tech, a student trying to recover a term paper overwritten with files from the alchemy department uncovers something monstrous on campus.
descriptions.c64:146679: A trainee midwife chases runaway babies around a maternity hospital, stopping them from poking electrical sockets, swallowing medicine and tumbling down lift shafts.
descriptions.c64:146680: Unofficial take on the Mario Bros Game & Watch: the brothers move up and down beside conveyor belts in a bottling plant, catching crates before they fall; supports two joysticks.
descriptions.c64:146681: R-Type-inspired side-scrolling shooter across six distinct levels of the planet Draconia, a world built by six dictators and crawling with grotesque life-forms.
descriptions.c64:146682: In a grim 2010, metal guitarist Ian finds his bandmate Sadok shot and hits streets crawling with mutants and thugs to learn who is targeting heavy metal bands.
descriptions.c64:146683: After the band Cyberpriest breaks up and Ian vanishes leaving a cryptic note, Joan, known as Phantasm, explores the town to find out what happened to him.
descriptions.c64:146684: Third Metal Warrior side-scrolling action adventure, with six playable characters, an expanded experience system for agility, strength and vitality, and a day-night cycle that changes encounters and shop hours.
descriptions.c64:146685: Three weeks after the third game, Joan and Ian are called to a meeting at a deserted farm by another musician, and Ian is pulled into a new adventure involving his past fights against a military conspiracy.
descriptions.c64:146686: Mickey reclaims Disney Castle from the Ogre King, shooting creatures while climbing stairways between floors and then exploring top-down rooms behind each door.
descriptions.c64:146687: Single-screen platformer about capturing monsters partying in a graveyard, using platform sections that rotate 90 degrees among rows of gravestones.
descriptions.c64:146688: Based on the TV comedy: a Mr. Gumby flings fish at flying feet and other surreal foes, with random interludes such as a lecture about the larch.
descriptions.c64:146689: Isometric sci-fi shooter across three levels, flying a ship that can reverse direction and change altitude to destroy airborne enemies and ground defense stations.
descriptions.c64:146709: Side-view trials riding, like Kikstart without an engine: set the speed and time the jumps across 12 timed courses packed with hills, ice, rocks, walls and spikes.
descriptions.c64:146710: Based on the Chewits sweets mascot: a prehistoric monster smashes houses and attackers while trying to recover its eggs from Japanese explorers.
descriptions.c64:146711: The Munsters have been spirited away to a mysterious castle; play family members in turn to rescue the rest, gathering items and shooting ghouls, zombies and vampires to build spell power.
descriptions.c64:146712: Six mini-games: Dr. Grump has made off with Miss Piggy, and Kermit, Gonzo, Fozzie and other Muppets brave the rides of his fun fair to save her.
descriptions.c64:146713: Movie platformer: Bastian answers the Childlike Empress's call to save Fantasia, outrunning giants or pushing them off ledges.
descriptions.c64:146722: Bullfighting: after entering a name, the would-be matador moves freely around the plaza ring, as does the bull, trying to rack up as many points as possible.
descriptions.c64:146754: Ferry ducks in a two-seat boat along the canals of Venice, catching them as they waddle out of the houses and leap toward the water.
descriptions.c64:146755: Edd the Duck, the BBC children's TV puppet, climbs vertically scrolling levels in a simplified Rainbow Islands style against a time limit.
descriptions.c64:146756: With the mining planet Sury Ani 7 contaminated and guarded by defense droids, pilot a Dedicated Disposal Droid to clear it remotely.
descriptions.c64:146757: Run-and-gun platformer moving left to right through each level on foot or across platforms, with an exoskeleton suit for added protection; many foes are better dodged than fought.
descriptions.c64:146791: Third OutRun game, a getaway from the police across Europe that changes vehicle by stage, including motorbikes and jet-skis.
descriptions.c64:146792: Text-based investigation: as a special investigator, sift through intelligence and send field agents after suspects to find the kidnapped U.S. President and other heads of state.
descriptions.c64:146793: As a NASA administrator, plan and build a space station over 15 years, scheduling shuttle launches, hiring staff, running research and balancing the budget.
descriptions.c64:146794: Defender-like scroller in which humans must be rescued twice, first from an alien ship and later from a city about to be overrun, with no smart bombs available.
descriptions.c64:146795: Ikari Warriors-style overhead shooter taking a soldier through six levels of gunfire and grenades, where vehicles, helicopters and traps can only be avoided.
descriptions.c64:146798: Based on the Hanna-Barbera horse sheriff: run along the roofs and sides of constantly scrolling trains to protect them from robbers.
descriptions.c64:146799: Rearrange track pieces on the screen to keep a train from crashing; the train can be turned around three times with fire, and the pace rises steadily.
descriptions.c64:146800: Design a model railroad layout with scenery and shipping and receiving sites, then run one or two steam or diesel trains with boxcars, cattle cars and other rolling stock.
descriptions.c64:146802: After a global war, survivors face the Sun going supernova and plan to fling the Moon into deep space with huge anti-gravity orbs.
descriptions.c64:146803: Head the Titanic Salvage Company: run press conferences and finances on the surface and explore the wreck below to salvage artifacts and eventually raise the ship.
descriptions.c64:146821: Robin Hood climbs ropes and collects flashing keys on each single-screen level of Nottingham Castle to free Maid Marion from the Sheriff.
descriptions.c64:146823: Scrappy-Doo punches his way through four levels of ledges, gaps and ladders to rescue Scooby and Shaggy from a castle, with Scooby Snacks granting extra lives.
descriptions.c64:146828: Strategy game set in the ancient Empire of Tiror, where a centuries-long drop in birth rate has left too few Tironians to run the colonies. From Magic Disk 64.
descriptions.c64:146829: Arithmetic quiz from the Cassette 50 compilation: it asks your name and age, then sets sums. A right answer adds a piece to your house and a wrong one adds a piece to the computer's, with the chance to retry a mistake.
descriptions.c64:146836: Gormless Gary braves Spooky Castle to rescue Princess Clare, whose hand King Michael has promised to her rescuer, avoiding bats, ghosts and fire that drain his energy.
descriptions.c64:146843: Sequel to Spy's Demise: a spy recovering from the Korean embassy job is summoned at 4 a.m. by the chief, with Ms Moneypenguin at the door, for a new assignment.
descriptions.c64:146847: Steg the slug blows bubbles to trap grubs, then floats or nudges them past obstacles to the nest so his hungry youngsters, the T'yungunz, get fed.
descriptions.c64:146851: Cartoon prison comedy: Bobo, serving seventeen years, peels potatoes, serves soup, helps fellow inmates escape, hops electric wires and sings snoring cellmates to sleep.
descriptions.c64:146856: Version of the Stratego board game: deploy 40 hidden pieces including a flag, five bombs and ranked units, then move one square at a time to capture the enemy flag.
descriptions.c64:146857: Carry a ghetto blaster through London's streets getting people dancing; once enough are grooving, take the tape to a record company, avoiding police and other troublemakers.
descriptions.c64:146858: Backyard baseball for one or two players in parks and vacant lots with improvised bases, mud puddles and tree stumps, shown on a split screen with an overview of the field.
descriptions.c64:146859: Second World War submarine simulation commanding American or German boats, six types across 60 missions, planning attacks around weather, terrain, radar and sonar with five levels of map detail.
descriptions.c64:146860: Side-scrolling shooter steering a ship through 16 caves of narrow passages, enemy formations, breakable walls, and gates that open when their small control boxes are shot.
descriptions.c64:146867: Overhead racing in the Super Sprint mold: nine tracks on each of four difficulty levels, run in any order, with prize money buying handling and other upgrades.
descriptions.c64:146868: Space geologist G-Man, stranded after missing the moonbus home, flies through the alien-infested Sea of Dreams in a scrolling shooter with gravity-based physics.
descriptions.c64:146869: Arcade-leaning helicopter game with missions including combat, POW rescue, Arctic rescue, an oil blaze, the Gulf of Terror and the Bermuda Triangle.
descriptions.c64:146870: Sequel to Nibbly '92: a snake travels between locations on an island map, then eats pills and grows longer in maze stages.
descriptions.c64:146871: A ninja sets out to restore shogun Yuichiro's honor by recovering a sword stolen by the villain Toranaga, fighting his way from a village up to the castle with martial arts and Japanese weapons.
descriptions.c64:146874: Fly the experimental UH-1XA helicopter, learning takeoff, flight and landing in flight school before missions such as finding and bombing an enemy base.
descriptions.c64:146875: Superman and Darkseid face off for one or two players over six sectors of Metropolis and its underground, one rescuing panicking citizens and the other luring them to his lair.
descriptions.c64:146876: Lighthearted RPG for younger players: an apprentice wizard whose master has taken away his spells completes three quests to win them back.
descriptions.c64:146877: In Victorian Scotland, aliens arrive with meteorites over Loch Ness and terrorize the locals; an old Scottish engineer's invention is the means to fight them.
descriptions.c64:146878: Boxing career game with a first-person split view of both fighters' faces, which bruise as the bout goes on; boxers are built by balancing strengths and weaknesses.
descriptions.c64:146881: Detailed AH-64 Apache helicopter simulator from Digital Integration, with airspeed tied to altitude and full control over rudder sideways movement and rolling.
descriptions.c64:146882: Fly an upgraded F-14 against ARTROCK 6, an artificial military island whose computer-run defenses went rogue after a storm and now attack anything nearby.
descriptions.c64:146884: A pirate text adventure driven by a two-word parser: seek out Treasure Isle and the vast hoard buried there, getting past tricky puzzles with lateral thinking. Given away with Commodore Format issue 61.
descriptions.c64:146885: Simon-style memory game: watch the computer's sequence, then repeat it exactly to advance to a longer one.
descriptions.c64:146886: Shooter dressed as a sports game, hurling balls to eliminate everyone on the opposing team before they get you. A sample game for The Games Creator.
descriptions.c64:146887: Text adventure built around Doctor Who and his time machine, the TARDIS.
descriptions.c64:146889: Horizontal car chase in the vein of Bump 'n' Jump, built with Mastertronic's The Games Creator construction kit.
descriptions.c64:146895: Fresh out of prison after the Long Ditton Spaghetti Caper, a crook digs for word of one last job big enough to retire on the Costa Brava, though its target and timing are still unknown.
descriptions.c64:146898: Race around a track collecting every dot before the opponent does while steering clear of the grey maniac.
descriptions.c64:146901: Horizontally scrolling road combat mixing Spy Hunter with Car Wars, more about shooting than ramming. Written as a demonstration for Mastertronic's Games Creator.
descriptions.c64:146905: Harry, a gun-toting hawk, clears the skies of gunships streaming in from both sides, avoiding the ground, aliens and rockets fired from below.
descriptions.c64:146910: Clear every stone from the board: selecting a square flips the four positions to its right and four below, while pickups grant extra lives, extra time and bombs.
descriptions.c64:146911: A hunter rounds up monkeys, lions and birds that escaped from a cage at the center of a jungle maze, using bananas to lure the monkeys back in.
descriptions.c64:146912: Ulopa, last of the slain Cariken family, sets out to recover the 23 shards of the amulet the druid Maldur shattered and restore rule over Gaspar.
descriptions.c64:146916: Space Invaders variant flying the F21 Condor, Earth's only fighter able to stop the alien attack, with four planes to finish the game.
descriptions.c64:146917: Captain James Hutch fights through multiple stages to bring down El Guato, a ruthless Mexican drug lord muscling into his city.
descriptions.c64:146920: Based on the British comic Viz: race one of three of its characters, Biffa Bacon, Johnny Fartpants or Buster Gonad, through five scrolling courses full of crude toilet humor.
descriptions.c64:146923: Pure strategy version of the War of the Ring, directing the forces of good across Middle-earth from the moment the Fellowship forms, without the 16-bit game's RPG questing.
descriptions.c64:146925: Galaxian-style shooter aboard a PT boat riding 30-foot waves, firing at enemy jets, helicopters and bombers while steering clear of mines.
descriptions.c64:146927: Pilot an F6F Hellcat in the wartime Pacific, flying off a carrier to bomb and strafe Japanese bunkers, gun nests and barracks across a chain of islands.
descriptions.c64:146941: Sequel to Ikari Warriors in which the commandos battle a stranger enemy: rock-headed beasts, green one-eyed creatures and other bizarre foes.
descriptions.c64:146943: Vincent the vampire has to reach his coffin in each horizontally scrolling level before time runs out, chopping enemies with his axe. Blood oranges act as his energy, crosses and stakes kill on touch, and mushroom-house shops sell boots, shields and smart bombs.
descriptions.c64:146944: Space combat around Alpha Centauri, where long ago a warp field generator was broken into 100 pieces and scattered to guard against a prophesied invasion through a rift in time.
descriptions.c64:146948: Unfinished overhead scrolling shooter meant to improve on Uridium; it was canceled, but a playable preview with intro music was released.
descriptions.c64:146949: Steer a dolphin through a huge ocean, learning to swim, dodging sharks, surfacing for air at least every eight minutes without getting caught in tuna boat nets, and searching for a color current.
descriptions.c64:146950: Obscure, nearly wordless exploration game loosely based on James Herbert's novel Domain: collect items, use them in other rooms, and fend off attacking rats and dogs.
descriptions.c64:146951: Text adventure on Olaxas, a planet ruined by war and now doomed, where the surviving Sha tribe must find a way off world.
descriptions.c64:146970: American football coaching and action: call plays from the sideline using the playbook or custom offensive and defensive plays, then run them on the field.
descriptions.c64:146971: A wandering stranger takes on the wizard Anthrax and the Demon he summoned, whose monster hordes are ravaging the kingdom.
descriptions.c64:146972: Side-view WWF-inspired wrestling with no menus, dropping straight into bouts in a ring shown in full.
descriptions.c64:146973: Tag-team WWF wrestling across four European cities, pairing two of Bret Hart, Hulk Hogan, Randy Savage and the Ultimate Warrior, fighting in and briefly out of the ring.
descriptions.c64:146976: Overhead pool table for one or two players with six game types of pocket pool and billiards, using the joystick and keys to break, shoot and bank.
descriptions.c64:146998: Donald Duck wants to be as rich as Uncle Scrooge, so he runs across a lawn in Duckburg catching the money drifting through the air. From Magic Disk 64.
descriptions.c64:147000: Preschool alphabet game for ages 2 to 5: Donald's 26 letters have escaped around the house, and pressing a key shows him finding and catching that letter.
descriptions.c64:147008: Fan remake of Donkey Kong Junior modeled on the Atari 7800 port, with new graphics and sound: Junior climbs vines to free his father from Mario, avoiding snap-jaws, birds and sparks.
descriptions.c64:147009: Version of the German board game Mensch argere dich nicht, a Pachisi-style race around a cross-shaped track where landing on a rival's peg sends it back to the start.
descriptions.c64:147011: Educational shooting gallery: words drift across the screen and the right ones are shot by hitting the target above them, in reading and rhyming variations.
descriptions.c64:147012: Dutch-language maze game with only a small part of the labyrinth visible at a time; it tracks position, steps taken and time spent, and teleporters can send the player back.
descriptions.c64:147013: Sequel to The Lords of Midnight: Shareth, daughter of the defeated Doomdark, has kidnapped Luxor's son Morkin, and Luxor, Rothron the Wise and Tarithel set out to find him.
descriptions.c64:147307: Loremaster Elidaan follows a scroll written by Fianna into the Deeps of Doriath to find the Coronet of Arien, which grants immortality and was cast down by Atelan, Lord of Time, when she spurned him.
descriptions.c64:147309: Timed picture puzzle: shift whole rows horizontally or diagonally to make the second window match the first, with 10 attempts per picture and three difficulty levels.
descriptions.c64:147310: Pac-Man clone: eat the dots in a maze while ghouls give chase, and grab a power dot to turn the tables and eat them for bonus points.
descriptions.c64:147312: The pencil-and-paper game on a 6x6 grid against the computer: take turns drawing lines between dots, and completing the fourth side of a box claims it.
descriptions.c64:147315: Two-player hybrid of Pong and Breakout played sideways, knocking out bricks between the paddles; includes a level editor. From Magic Disk 64.
descriptions.c64:147319: Breakout with two paddles, each on its own joystick; it can be shared by two players, but it was designed for one player working both sticks at once.
descriptions.c64:147367: Konami basketball for one or two players: choose teams and game length and jump straight into play, controlling whichever player has or is about to get the ball.
descriptions.c64:147368: Aerial combat against enemy bases and planes, including head-to-head dogfights with a second player.
descriptions.c64:147369: Choose-your-path graphic text adventure in which the player is shrunk to two inches tall while using the computer early in the morning and must find the computer manual.
descriptions.c64:147370: Choose-your-path mystery: after dreaming that a friend has gone missing in deserted Belmore Manor, the player goes to investigate and finds the house full of Space Wimps arcade machines.
descriptions.c64:147371: Choose-your-path mystery at Uncle Ralph's house on the Maine coast, where guests gather for the unveiling of a newly acquired Egyptian statue and trouble follows overnight.
descriptions.c64:147372: Choose-your-path graphic text adventure set on a family camping trip, waking early to explore by hiking through the woods or canoeing down the river.
descriptions.c64:147373: Commando-style shooter with a twist: both soldiers are controlled at the same time. Built with SEUCK for the 2014 SEUCK Compo.
descriptions.c64:147375: Space rugby: a cyan astronaut takes on a computer-controlled rival in a made-up sci-fi sport resembling American football.
descriptions.c64:147393: Ski down a slope steering left and right around trees, houses and other obstacles, at a chosen difficulty. Part of the Cassette 50 compilation.
descriptions.c64:147397: Explore room by room, solving puzzles and gathering the items that prevent a permanent transformation into Dr Jackle, through a park and a labyrinth past spikes and green bottles.
descriptions.c64:147398: Platformer in which a scientist hurls purple vials at Martian invaders disguised as animals in his city, avoiding contact with them, obstacles and bullets.
descriptions.c64:147399: Mistaken for a hero, a weakling is sent by King Notlob to save his 16 daughters from the equally puny Dr. Pimple, who has hidden them in minefields with concealed mines across nine levels.
descriptions.c64:147400: Timed multiple-choice quiz on human relationships written by Dr. Ruth Westheimer and her researchers, with answers that are not always obvious and a score that rewards speed.
descriptions.c64:147401: The Grinch, the Cat in the Hat and other Seuss characters get their heads, bodies and feet scrambled across a 3x3 grid; swap pieces one at a time to rebuild them.
descriptions.c64:147402: Three linked text adventures following Bram Stoker's novel, starting with Jonathan Harker's journey to Count Dracula's castle; each part can be played separately.
descriptions.c64:147404: Drag racing against a human or computer rival in one of five car types, working the throttle and shifting through two to four gears to cross the line first.
descriptions.c64:147534: Fly a dragon around the screen shooting falling debris before it hits the dragon or the ground.
descriptions.c64:147538: Horizontal shooter: a space explorer surveys a lush planet of water, forests and ancient ruins, overrun by dragons that kill on contact. From Game On magazine.
descriptions.c64:147581: A young prince recovers the king's treasure from dragon-guarded castles, first crossing the drawbridge while jumping and ducking fireballs, then grabbing the loot inside.
descriptions.c64:147611: Vertical shooter where numbered pods add new sections to the ship, building up firepower until the final piece turns it into a blazing phoenix.
descriptions.c64:147615: Children's adventure in the style of Sierra's Hi-Res Adventures: travel from home to rescue 16 animals, from a puppy and a turtle to a bear and a raccoon, captured by a dragon.
descriptions.c64:147616: Ghosts 'n Goblins-inspired multi-directional scroller: Darius fights the demons that the King of Demons unleashed from the Swamp of Soggoth to darken the land of Thalax.
descriptions.c64:147617: Further scenes loosely adapted from the Dragon's Lair laserdisc game: having slain Singe and rescued Daphne, Dirk the Daring is still restless for adventure.
descriptions.c64:147618: Text adventure in the fallen land of Astoria, lured by tales of Princess Lianna and the huge magical gemstone known as the Dragonstone.
descriptions.c64:147620: Illustrated adventure based on the Dragonworld novel: a messenger reports that the world's final dragon has been abducted, and its rescue requires traveling with the companion Hawkwind.
descriptions.c64:147622: Graphic adventure about destroying Count Dracula before the vampire claims you, starting with an urgent search for a cross.
descriptions.c64:147636: Basketball tournament named after Drazen Petrovic, played as a knockout from the round of 16 to the title.
descriptions.c64:147676: A cute green monster lost in a forest of hostile creatures needs help finding a way out. From Starlight magazine, and released in Italy as Sogno.
descriptions.c64:147677: Three-on-three basketball featuring Dominique Wilkins, Patrick Ewing and Joe Dumars on asphalt and hardwood courts, with 15 set plays and a tool for designing new ones.
descriptions.c64:147678: In a future run by corporations that fight wars in dreams with demons, a resistance fighter tries to free friends held by Ocular.
descriptions.c64:147679: Fantasy football manager: draft, bench and trade NFL players backed by a database of player statistics.
descriptions.c64:147681: Having drifted off to sleep, the hero finds himself trapped inside a dangerous world built from his own imagination and must find a way back to waking reality.
descriptions.c64:147683: Loosely based on the pencil-and-paper dots-and-boxes game: as the last free Drelb, swivel the grid's gates to close off squares while dodging the Trolloboars and Gorgolytes who roam the maze.
descriptions.c64:147685: Explore an abandoned space station in solid 3D polygon graphics, finding where explosive gas is building up in each of its 18 sectors and drilling to vent it before the whole place blows.
descriptions.c64:147686: A night-out simulator: stagger between bars trying to impress friends and women while keeping enough cash for the next round, picking drinks wisely to avoid being sick or passing out.
descriptions.c64:147687: Gather the coins that spilled from a bank-bound car across 42 side-scrolling platform levels, throwing a ball to stun the creatures that cost a life on contact, then head for the exit.
descriptions.c64:147697: A single-screen shooter on the bandit-held planet Xeviou, where an unarmed robot heading for the central computer needs a protector to keep enemies off it.
descriptions.c64:147698: A bored shipboard droid dreams of heroics: across six levels of a stricken spaceship, collect objects and put them where they belong while avoiding hostile droids and electrodes.
descriptions.c64:147699: Steer a robot through a monster-infested landscape, hunting down the creatures to wipe them out while evading the other attackers.
descriptions.c64:147702: As Floyd, a cleaning droid built for work too grim for humans, roam the city sewers clearing out the mess and the creatures living there.
descriptions.c64:147704: Based on the TV show: players each represent a European country and take turns at six timed arcade events, scoring as many points as possible to win overall.
descriptions.c64:147795: A storm-damaged computer called EDWARD has turned the unmanned warship Arachnid into a menace that will destroy Venus within a day; board the ship and shut it down.
descriptions.c64:147799: A text adventure that begins in a bedroom with no instructions: examine the surroundings, gather useful tools and survive a shifting world while helping others.
descriptions.c64:147800: A party take on Pong with small, medium, large or super-sized paddles to choose from.
descriptions.c64:147802: Sequel to Druid: guide the warlock through eight mazes, collecting health and extra weapons while a single, steadily draining energy bar serves as the only life.
descriptions.c64:147805: Two hunters, each with a dog, compete to shoot the most ducks with a double-barrelled shotgun, then send their dogs out to fetch the birds.
descriptions.c64:147808: A multi-directional scrolling platformer: explore huge caverns and chambers in search of a scepter, fighting monsters with a weapon that fires automatically in the direction of travel and avoiding lava pits.
descriptions.c64:147812: Down the most ducks possible using a rifle fixed in place. Released on a Commodore public domain games collection.
descriptions.c64:147824: In the style of Atic Atac, Pothole Pete explores a top-down maze of rooms, hunting for the four parts of the Golden Lion that are his only way out of the Lair.
descriptions.c64:147825: In Arabia, the last fit man of a looted and starving village crosses burning desert to sneak into the Sultan's private chamber and take back the gold.
descriptions.c64:147833: Two players face off in a Wild West quick-draw gunfight to see who is fastest. Published in La Voce 2.
descriptions.c64:147839: Race the computer or a friend over three courses on skates or a BMX, pulling off jumps and grabbing tokens within two minutes on a horizontally split screen.
descriptions.c64:147840: Fly a helicopter or a plane over a contested border, destroying the largest possible number of enemy units.
descriptions.c64:147842: The sequel to Test Drive: drive a Ferrari F40 or Porsche 959 against the clock or a rival in the other car, dodging traffic through stages that run through forests and mountains.
descriptions.c64:147912: A German-language maze collecting game in the Pac-Man mould: use doors, teleporters and other aids to progress while steering clear of ghosts and monsters.
descriptions.c64:147920: A Wizard of Wor clone for one or two players: hunt monsters through winding dungeon corridors with well-aimed shots. Appeared on several German magazine disks.
descriptions.c64:147924: A first-person dungeon role-playing game drawn in PETSCII characters, exploring for experience and treasure.
descriptions.c64:147926: To prove the right to rule Jasoom, recover the fabled Jasoomian diamond from an ancient castle abandoned for 1000 years and now home to giants, serpents and spiders.
descriptions.c64:147928: An Atic Atac-style adventure starring a bald, eyepatched pirate against comical enemies, with combat that rewards quick key presses to save energy.
descriptions.c64:147933: An adventure that opens at a quaint roadside inn, where the landlord may have local information or tasks to help with the quest.
descriptions.c64:147934: A table tennis game for two, played either with two joysticks or with a joystick and the keyboard.
descriptions.c64:147935: Two players drop blocks into the same Tetris well together, cooperating to clear lines. Published in Game On magazine.
descriptions.c64:147937: An eight-way scrolling space shooter inspired by Hunter's Moon with a touch of Time Pilot, first written in 1988 and finally released in GO64! in 2004.
descriptions.c64:147938: Two biplane pilots duel above a European city, each trying to shoot the other down.
descriptions.c64:147940: Switch between a bird and a dwarf as they explore a haunted castle, hunting for ten hidden keys needed to open the calculation room. The screen shows the action, a map and status.
descriptions.c64:147941: Rob a bank against the clock, feeling a way through an invisible maze to the safe; pressing fire reveals a map. Part of the Cassette 50 compilation.
descriptions.c64:147943: Secret agent Dynamite Dan lands his Zeppelin on Dr Blitzen's house and searches it for eight sticks of dynamite to blow the vault and seize the Mega-Ray plans.
descriptions.c64:147948: A text adventure for children: after an earthquake wrecks a shopping centre, help the other survivors and find a way out.
descriptions.c64:147954: An arcade adventure starring an electric man who must avoid damage and keep his charge topped up.
descriptions.c64:147955: A Pong clone for one or two players, with background graphics and music. Published in Game On magazine.
descriptions.c64:147956: Based on the arcade game and the Tenchi o Kurau manga, ride into battle on horseback as a warrior of China's Three Kingdoms era, cutting down infantry and archers.
descriptions.c64:147958: Pilot the attack chopper Dyter-07 against alien invaders over four tropical islands, clearing each in side-scrolling flight and rescuing scientists; eight levels alternate two styles of play.
descriptions.c64:147969: A three-part mission to rescue scientists stranded on the planet Helcara, where an enemy force has built a base near their research establishment and captured some of them.
descriptions.c64:148021: Track Carmen Sandiego and her gang through both place and time, questioning witnesses and searching locations for clues to make the arrest. Came with a reference book for research.
descriptions.c64:148028: Fight through dangerous lands to free a princess held in a temple by a Pharaoh, battling winged monsters, dog-headed creatures and hybrids one at a time in side-view combat.
descriptions.c64:148066: In 2200 AD, with humans and aliens long at peace, only the hostile Mecanoidz keep fighting Earth, and they have secretly built the battleship Meca Hawk to strike at it.
descriptions.c64:148067: An educational adventure across more than 20 pictures where a small dog leads from station to station, each requiring three multiplication problems; several difficulty levels.
descriptions.c64:148068: A horizontal shooter on a constantly scrolling screen: blast waves of alien ships, using the fact that only the ship's centre is vulnerable to scrape its edges past danger.
descriptions.c64:148071: Steer a baby across multiple screens to a bottle of milk, dodging the nightmarish things that come at it and keeping it off the greens.
descriptions.c64:148072: Help Suzanne catch the eggs a mad farmer keeps hurling; each egg that hits the ground and breaks costs one of her three chances.
descriptions.c64:148073: An early, pared-down Egg Catcher made for the 2004 4K Mini Gaming Competition: catch falling eggs in a basket before they break on the ground.
descriptions.c64:148074: A take on the MSX puzzle series Eggerland: as Lolo, a little blue ball with arms and legs, solve rooms to rescue Princess Lala from King Egger. Released on a Reset disk.
descriptions.c64:148075: Line up three yellow eggs horizontally or vertically. Pushed eggs slide until they hit something, pushed stones can squash monsters, and passwords mark progress every few stages.
descriptions.c64:148080: Memory training software that teaches techniques such as the method of loci and peg words for recalling names, faces, phone numbers and dates.
descriptions.c64:148082: Released during the 1987 UK general election, this arcade adventure has players pick one of five parody candidates, such as Matcher and Ninnock, and campaign to become Prime Minister.
descriptions.c64:148083: One to four players lead a British party (Conservative, Labour, Liberal Democrat or Independent) through a general election, each starting with £8000 to canvass across 60 constituencies.
descriptions.c64:148085: Run a Republican presidential campaign against a Democrat played by the computer or a second player over 20 periods, working from a US map split into state and region views.
descriptions.c64:148102: A Centipede variant: shoot the ant-like creatures marching down the screen, then destroy the tombstone each leaves behind. Part of The Entertainer collection.
descriptions.c64:148164: A horizontal shooter in the vein of Uridium: fly over platforms orbiting different stars, collecting all 48 radioactive crystals on a level before landing on the runway.
descriptions.c64:148166: A coloring book from the Electric Crayon series with 30 pictures of the Turtles at world landmarks such as the Kremlin, the Taj Mahal and Mount Fuji, filled in from a 16-color palette.
descriptions.c64:148193: A soccer game carrying the name of Spanish striker Emilio Butragueño, offering single matches between a white team and a red team with no league or tournament.
descriptions.c64:148284: In 2034 the machines have turned against humanity; fly a horizontally scrolling shooter collecting every electrical cord before the fuel runs out. From the Red Ribbon Game Pak.
descriptions.c64:148286: One or two players each control an orb in an overhead arena, bumping a grey ball into the opposing goal while guarding their own.
descriptions.c64:148287: Ride a futuristic motorbike against the clock through England, Australia or America, swerving around bouncing globes, spinning prisms and screens dropped by aircraft.
descriptions.c64:148288: As an electrician, repair the vandalized underground cables of a Los Angeles power station across 20 timed flick-screen platform levels joined by ladders.
descriptions.c64:148290: Keep a man alive as a runaway elevator plunges toward him, using daring and acrobatic moves to avoid being crushed.
descriptions.c64:148292: A Christmas game in which an elf grabs every present while snowmen give chase, then freezes the snowmen in place with Christmas trees to finish the level.
descriptions.c64:148293: Sent by Grayfax, set out on an adventure quest to find Durin the elf.
descriptions.c64:148295: A maze game for young players: lead a little monster through rooms of platforms, avoiding the Burgermonster and Shoemonster and reaching the exit quickly for more points.
descriptions.c64:148296: Collect seven potions scattered across the land and pour one on each of the unbloomed Finvarra flowers before dusk, so the Faerie Queen of Elidon can be crowned with their garland.
descriptions.c64:148300: A version of Joseph Weizenbaum's 1966 Eliza program, which imitates a Rogerian therapist by turning typed statements back into questions and prompting for more.
descriptions.c64:148301: A text adventure in the village of Moonholm, where the ghost of Sir Roger Durwood, known as Blackbeard, cannot rest until the Ellisnore Diamond is found.
descriptions.c64:148305: An unofficial follow-up to E.T.: Elliot rescues E.T.s from a meteor-battered dying world and carries them back to the mothership for extra points; any meteor reaching the ground costs a life.
descriptions.c64:148306: A flick-screen platformer starring an elf who recovers the indestructible Book of Immortality from the ashes of the burned Black Witch.
descriptions.c64:148371: After bailing out of a plane caught in a storm over the Bermuda Triangle, a courier lands on Emerald Isle, which legend says only its ruler may ever leave. A text adventure.
descriptions.c64:148372: A Boulder Dash-style cave game: dig for emeralds and diamonds while avoiding monsters and falling rocks, with a two-player mode for clearing caves together.
descriptions.c64:148373: The follow-up to Emerald Mine plays the same Boulder Dash-style way, digging for gems under falling stones, and adds a level editor.
descriptions.c64:148375: Based on pub quiz machines: answer questions to work through ten scrolling block mazes, heading right toward the Win bar before the screen pushes you into the Lose bar at the left edge.
descriptions.c64:148440: As Edison the kinetic android, complete a working closed circuit across a side-scrolling grid while dodging bouncing electrical charges called Nohms. Six difficulty levels.
descriptions.c64:148453: Build a galactic empire behind a huge frontier shield by flying missions, trading with starbases and fighting off alien invaders from a top-down view of the ship.
descriptions.c64:148454: Interactive fiction sequel: an otherworldly stranger and Darin, descendant of the hero Beren, try to stop the king of Vorzdeshaa from overthrowing the Emperor of Karn.
descriptions.c64:148456: A military strategy game for two to four players on a choice of five maps, where the aim is to wipe out every rival army and become Lord of Empius.
descriptions.c64:148457: A trainee sorcerer's final test: in an enchanted cottage, discover what lies behind the green door, using a colored cube that transports to three other places. A text adventure.
descriptions.c64:148486: Magic has been outlawed, and the mischievous goblins, elves and spirits holed up in the Enchanted Forest must be driven out to make the world safe.
descriptions.c64:148490: Infocom text adventure: a lowly apprentice enchanter, armed with only basic spells, sets out to defeat the warlock Krill after the senior enchanters have proven powerless.
descriptions.c64:148491: Final part of Infocom's Enchanter trilogy: as leader of the Circle of Enchanters, investigate why magic itself is failing after a crisis erupts at a gathering of the guilds.
descriptions.c64:148496: Skim over an alien city collecting fuel and other supplies, searching for the aliens' main fuel dump to destroy it and save humanity from slavery.
descriptions.c64:148498: Two players compete to spear the fish swimming above them.
descriptions.c64:148499: The cave system Eindeloos, once a tourist attraction, has been taken over by an angry alien being woken on one of Neptune's moons.
descriptions.c64:148500: Scroll through platform levels as Al 'Dutch Meat' Bluntz on a mission to rescue his girlfriend Jane from the Manic Munk's lair in Milton Keynes.
descriptions.c64:148501: Manage an American football team, climbing from the second division to the first and on to the Superbowl, buying and selling players and picking the side before each game.
descriptions.c64:148502: Manage a rugby league team, buying and selling players and picking the lineup, aiming to rise from Division 2 to the Division 1 title and win cups.
descriptions.c64:148503: Steer a patrol boat down hostile waters, avoiding shoals and enemy vessels.
descriptions.c64:148685: Two players drive tanks side by side through hostile ground, scoring by striking enemies when the gauge at the foot of the screen reads high.
descriptions.c64:148686: Humpty the engineer guides a spanner into the works through layouts of conveyor belts and machinery; the full layout shows briefly, then only a small part around the spanner stays visible.
descriptions.c64:148687: Humpty runs around his garden opening and closing water valves to send water through pipes to the flowers, trying to grow enough before the weeds take over.
descriptions.c64:148688: Rotate the maze 90 degrees at a time so Humpty falls toward the exit, steering him clear of bombs, snappers and Fuzzy Wuzzies; teleports move him around.
descriptions.c64:148689: A top-down soccer game with the England squad, released to follow England's 1990 World Cup semi-final and influenced by the Kick Off series.
descriptions.c64:148692: Following Shadowfire, the Enigma team escort the captured General Zoff to the Emperor as war spreads across the galaxy.
descriptions.c64:148695: A white-robed ninja fights rival ninjas crossing the screen, dodging their shurikens and nunchakus as well as stars thrown from atop a brick wall. Made with The Games Creator.
descriptions.c64:148697: A Victorian solitaire puzzle on 17 squares forming two overlapping diamonds: swap the positions of eight white and eight black tiles using the single empty space.
descriptions.c64:148711: A multi-directional space shooter where money collected in each level buys weapon and ship upgrades between stages, with bonus levels mixed in.
descriptions.c64:148715: In 2010, pilot NASA's newest ship into an asteroid circling Earth to explore its five storage caves, each protected by its own security system, moving and shooting in all directions.
descriptions.c64:148730: Clear every block from a 19x9 board within limited moves; selecting a square flips it and its neighbors, emptying filled spaces and filling empty ones.
descriptions.c64:148734: A side-scrolling platformer where a baby-like hero fires goo from his navel and must gather every piece of fruit on each level, fending off snails, lizards and bouncing jelly.
descriptions.c64:148748: Ride 12 showjumping courses against the clock alone or against up to five others, seen from an elevated side view. Released in Europe as Harvey Smith Showjumper.
descriptions.c64:148838: Create a band of as many as eight adventurers to recover a magic crown from the wizard Tarmon, sealed in his laboratory for 500 years. Battles are tactical, with each party member moved individually.
descriptions.c64:149222: Grover helps children practice counting, addition and subtraction through five space-themed number activities, including How Many Zips? and Beam That Number.
descriptions.c64:149225: Ernie the Magician conjures two shapes with his wand and children decide whether they match; matching shapes float together and vanish.
descriptions.c64:149227: Children catch and match letters riding a turning Ferris wheel with the Muppets, practicing upper and lower case recognition, simple spelling and word building.
descriptions.c64:149228: Children explore five neighborhood settings and build scenes with Sesame Street characters and everyday objects, learning about the community.
descriptions.c64:149229: A turn-based number board game for two: one player picks digits along rows, the other along columns, gaining points for digits in their own color and losing them for the opponent's until the board is empty.
descriptions.c64:149230: Guide a small worm through a city park, eating whatever is good while slipping past obstacles and sneaky enemies. Published in a 64'er special issue.
descriptions.c64:149240: A text adventure about breaking out of a Nazi prison camp by either of two escape routes. The first attempt always fails, and movement around the camp is only allowed in daylight.
descriptions.c64:149241: Infocom comedy adventure: the late B-movie mogul Buddy Burbank's estate, full of props from films like Attack of the Killer Rutabagas, must be searched for hidden treasures to claim the inheritance.
descriptions.c64:149243: Picking up a small stone tablet triggers a gray fog, and the hero wakes in a desert; follow the clues to unravel the tablet's mystery. From the On the Run collection.
descriptions.c64:149250: A generation after the earlier adventures, earthquakes and tidal waves batter Llylgamyn, and a party descends in search of the Orb of Scrying, the city's hoped-for salvation.
descriptions.c64:149252: A follow-on scenario to the first Wizardry, built to take imported characters rather than new ones: explore a wireframe 3D dungeon to recover the Staff of Gnilda and the Knight of Diamonds' armor.
descriptions.c64:149255: Assemble a party and descend through a ten-level dungeon below Trebor's castle, created by the archmage Werdna, to recover the Mad Overlord's stolen amulet. Explored in first-person wireframe 3D.
descriptions.c64:149279: Dig through dirt, pebbles and dust to recover the missing crown jewels before falling pebbles trap you or the clock runs out. From the Amazing Journeys collection.
descriptions.c64:149394: Loosely based on the board game: command four prisoners of war, a Briton, a Frenchman, a Pole and an American, controlling each separately as they try to break out of Colditz Castle.
descriptions.c64:149396: A text adventure about a crew stranded on Mars, gathering the parts needed to repair the ship and leave the planet.
descriptions.c64:149399: Help Joe climb to the top of a vast scrolling maze using ropes, switching ladders, stairs, lifts and springs while avoiding creatures that patrol small areas.
descriptions.c64:149400: Recover the Golden Baton, a sacred artifact that keeps peace in the land, stolen from King Ferrenuil's palace. Wolves, crabs, a boat trip and a magic crystal stand in the way of this text adventure.
descriptions.c64:149401: Fourth in the Mysterious Adventures series, inspired by Alien: alone on a giant spaceship after a mutated zoo specimen has killed the rest of the crew, find a way to escape.
descriptions.c64:149402: An illustrated text adventure where a dying alien race asks for treasures scattered around to be gathered and returned to save them.
descriptions.c64:149404: A reporter investigating an eccentric professor on the moors finds his house deserted and must recover three missing prisms that control his time machine to rescue him.
descriptions.c64:149405: The king asks for his daughter to be rescued from an evil wizard. A text adventure in the Mysterious Adventures series, driven by compass moves and two-word commands.
descriptions.c64:149406: Greek myth as a text adventure: Perseus gathers a sword, shield and sandals so he can kill Medusa and save Princess Andromeda.
descriptions.c64:149407: Inspired by Agatha Christie's And Then There Were None, search the late Major Johnstone-Smythe's estate for his gold statue among ten worthless colored copies he hid.
descriptions.c64:149502: Follow-up to Volcano of Raka-Tua: the island's volcano has erupted and lava is spreading, so find a way to survive and get off the island. A text adventure with pictures.
descriptions.c64:149503: A Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit game based on Escape from New York, in which Snake Plissken fights his way out through a thug-filled city.
descriptions.c64:149506: Captured with fellow rebels by King Safuis II's secret police, break out of the Dungeon of the Gods to rejoin the uprising against his tyranny.
descriptions.c64:149507: A text adventure on the foul planet Stank: explore rooms, gather useful items, solve puzzles and avoid hazards to get away alive. Re-released in an enhanced version in 2003.
descriptions.c64:149508: An Italian platformer about breaking out of an underground prison, dodging or fighting the jailers and many hazards along the way.
descriptions.c64:149511: An isometric shooter in the style of Gauntlet: land on robot-ruled Planet X, blast the machines and rescue the human survivors.
descriptions.c64:149512: Thrown into a giant waste disposal unit on arrival at an alien world, escape through levels of garbage by trailing a beam behind the craft and touching rubbish with it.
descriptions.c64:149514: Turn-based fantasy strategy from the Gollop brothers, drawing on Chaos and Laser Squad: up to four wizards, human or computer, battle with spells and summoned creatures in a newly made world.
descriptions.c64:149515: Turn-based preview of Lords of Chaos in which a wizard thrown into Zol's dark prison must gather the scattered keys and find the door to another world, trading moves with the computer-controlled Zol amid combat, items and rideable creatures.
descriptions.c64:149537: Pick a maze type and size, then work through to the end without getting caught by the monster.
descriptions.c64:149539: Pilot a wobbly hot-air balloon through tunnels and caves against the clock, landing safely without touching the walls, much like a more involved Lunar Lander.
descriptions.c64:149540: Detective Eric Hawthorne of the Apex agency is assigned to recover the rare Acme Diamond from the thief Icelady, in a game mixing 1950s B-movie style with arcade, strategy and board game elements.
descriptions.c64:149542: A WWII bomber pilot, shot down on the way home, wakes in a barn behind enemy lines and sets out on foot to reach safety.
descriptions.c64:149543: Get off the Starship Elektra and reach the planet Zanuss, where a time machine waits in the alien city.
descriptions.c64:149641: Italy, January 1942: a captured officer who kept secret Allied campaign plans out of enemy hands must escape from a prisoner of war camp. A text adventure.
descriptions.c64:149642: Set in the Ice Age, Eskimo Eddie jumps across platforms to reach Percy Penguin, held captive by Growler the polar bear, in a two-level arcade adventure.
descriptions.c64:149644: Winter games with a twist: events include Operation Snowball, a Cabal-style shooting gallery where snowballs are thrown at catapult builders and their shots blasted, and Eggsterminator.
descriptions.c64:149646: Fly low over a gigantic enemy spaceship, fighting off endless waves of attackers with lasers while missiles fired at the same time strike the ship below.
descriptions.c64:149648: A text adventure about stealing the blueprints of a secret military spy satellite.
descriptions.c64:149650: Enter an untouched Inca temple in the South American jungle to grab as much treasure as possible, past traps, a Sacrificial Chamber, a room of fire and a pool. A text adventure.
descriptions.c64:149651: Pulled aboard an alien slaver cruiser by a graviton beam, work with Fred the pet android to free the ship before its crew can swap human brains for microchips. A text adventure.
descriptions.c64:149652: Shot down over an enemy island, bring the plane under control, locate the stronghold and get back past enemy fire. A text adventure.
descriptions.c64:149713: A real-time text adventure aboard the Starship Essex, where a tour is interrupted by a dying agent who sends you after a scientist and the formula he holds against the alien Vollchons. Came with a novella.
descriptions.c64:149714: As the Empire's greatest psychic, recover 24 stolen pieces of the snake god Estra's statue from the Raal Temple on Reonzar, shown in an overhead single-screen view around a central force field.
descriptions.c64:149715: An Eskimo child sets out after a curious younger brother who keeps wandering off, getting tangled in odd adventures along the way.
descriptions.c64:149716: Etarip is Pirate backwards: place crosshairs over targets on the high seas and land as many missiles as possible.
descriptions.c64:149717: Guide a small robot with unlimited ammo through side-scrolling science fiction levels to the exit before time runs out, avoiding enemies that drain energy and traps such as stalactites and hooks that cost a life.
descriptions.c64:149719: Rugby union released alongside the 1991 World Cup: play the full 16-team tournament, an 8-team league or friendlies, with 10 skill levels and adjustable match length.
descriptions.c64:149721: Play the four-handed card game Euchre with a computer partner against two computer opponents; the computer deals and keeps score.
descriptions.c64:149723: A series of illustrated adventures spread across points in history, hunting for the missing pieces of a talisman discovered on the Moon and shattered by fusion lasers.
descriptions.c64:149725: World War II air strategy over Britain, France and Germany: as Goering or Portal, set campaign priorities and tactical doctrine for hundreds of aircraft, then watch the results unfold.
descriptions.c64:149755: Indoor five-a-side football against the computer or a second player, viewed top-down at a slight angle, with the ball rebounding off the arena walls.
descriptions.c64:149759: A football game tied to the 1992 European Championships that scrolls at a slight angle, shows a scanner of the whole pitch and zooms in close after goals like the arcade original.
descriptions.c64:149760: A multi-event sports game of joystick waggling and well-timed button presses across several track and field style disciplines.
descriptions.c64:149761: Manage a side through the old straight knock-out version of the European Cup, with seven skill levels, editable player ratings and squads importable from Premier II.
descriptions.c64:149762: A geography program covering European countries, capitals and landforms, plus history and current facts, with room to add custom homework questions.
descriptions.c64:149763: Pick one of fourteen European football clubs, Wrexham among them, and play another person or the computer on a top-down pitch, controlling whichever player is closest to the ball.
descriptions.c64:149770: Drive the Southern Belle steam train, hauled by a King Arthur class locomotive, from London Victoria to Brighton in the era before electrification, with a demo mode and seven scenarios.
descriptions.c64:149773: Based on the 1980s UK quiz show: three couples or six individuals answer questions to win seconds, which the leaders then spend in the final round.
descriptions.c64:149777: Hunt for hidden treasure in South Africa, shooting monsters before they touch you. Included in The Big 100 compilation.
descriptions.c64:149779: Track down and destroy the evil prince in this text adventure with graphics, published in Commodore Scene.
descriptions.c64:149780: The kingdom of Picar has fallen to evil, and only the Sceptre of Lawfulness, hidden in the ruins of the Aranto stronghold, can save it.
descriptions.c64:149783: A Bard's Tale-style role-playing game with a single hero: a wizard's apprentice roams the land and its dungeons to pass a final test made up of five challenges.
descriptions.c64:149784: A text adventure first written in BASIC for the PET, where the hero wields Excalibur against the evil plaguing the land.
descriptions.c64:149787: A word game modeled on the TV show Countdown: choose vowels and consonants one at a time, then make the longest word possible. Part of Cassette 50.
descriptions.c64:149874: Steer Kirby around platform levels collecting every dot while avoiding the creatures, then advance to a tougher stage.
descriptions.c64:149875: A science fiction Sokoban variant: push colored spheres onto spots marked X without jamming them against each other or the walls.
descriptions.c64:149877: Circle the outside of an octagonal prison called The Pit, shooting inward at creatures trying to escape from its centre while taking care never to hit your friend Spud.
descriptions.c64:149880: Lead four explorers, a medic, field assistant, radio operator and guard, into the Amazon to survey and loot Inca ruins, starting by buying supplies.
descriptions.c64:149932: An Arkanoid-style bat-and-ball game where the playfield is wider than one screen, so the ball can be sent off to the left or right to reach more bricks.
descriptions.c64:150003: Fend off a UFO invasion from a missile launcher that can roam the screen, loading each missile before it can be fired at the craft descending from above.
descriptions.c64:150004: Wipe out alien pirates across three distinct sections, beginning with a ship-based shooting stage where touching aliens drains energy.
descriptions.c64:150006: Based on the board game: two to four players try to get enough of their colored stones onto matching squares of a board built on two rotating spirals.
descriptions.c64:150007: A shaman explores an Egyptian pyramid in search of the Eye of Horus, changing between human and bird form at will to get past its traps.
descriptions.c64:150010: Enter a lost Inca temple found in a jungle clearing and search for the Eye of the Inca, said to be the world's largest diamond.
descriptions.c64:150016: Run a Formula 1 team on a budget of about $6 million, hiring drivers, buying cars and staff, then race on 16 well-known circuits.
descriptions.c64:150024: An improved F.1 Manager with English and Italian text and extra graphics and features: handle a Formula 1 team's money and engineering, then drive the races.
descriptions.c64:150027: A side-scrolling shooter: fly a Tornado over four Middle Eastern levels, destroying enemy fighters and ground targets, with a large piece of military hardware waiting at the end of each.
descriptions.c64:150028: A Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit creation featuring Zelda-like visuals, transitions from day to night and a raft section.
descriptions.c64:150029: Spared by a security officer on condition of doing a job, travel down to Copus to find the Fabulous Wanda, also called Jet-Bike, and learn the secret of life from her.
descriptions.c64:150123: A strange creature guards a face in the middle of the screen from objects that move about, removing them by throwing its hat and avoiding being touched.
descriptions.c64:150124: A trivia board game for one player against the computer or two players: buzz in within 10 seconds, type the answer, and move around a rectangular board.
descriptions.c64:150125: A math game for two players or one against the computer: players alternately pick numbers from a grid, each pick having to be a factor of the opponent's previous number.
descriptions.c64:150126: An introduction to programming ideas for children: build a step-by-step production line of machines that punch holes, rotate and paint bands to reproduce a target plate.
descriptions.c64:150249: After waving a magic wand found on a walk, the hero lands in a strange land and must collect treasure by solving puzzles and dealing with fantasy creatures and people. A text adventure.
descriptions.c64:150256: The talisman protecting Holm has been stolen by the Necromancer, and three brothers take turns venturing across a vast open world to recover it after their father is killed.
descriptions.c64:150260: Based on Ray Bradbury's novel: Guy Montag, a fireman who burns books, turns rebel and, with help from the Underground, evades the authorities in a future where books are banned.
descriptions.c64:150264: A Boulder Dash cave set from Falcon Soft with 23 new and fairly easy caves. Published in GO64!.
descriptions.c64:150265: Twenty-one new Boulder Dash caves made by the Czech group Falcon Soft.
descriptions.c64:150266: Seventeen new Boulder Dash caves from Falcon Soft, released for New Year's Eve 2004.
descriptions.c64:150270: As a time lord aboard the ship Falcon's Wing, hunt a renegade TIME agent who swaps artifacts between eras, then leave the ship with a jet pack and laser to put them back, guided by the onboard computer CAIN.
descriptions.c64:150271: Steer a space fighter with joystick or trackball to destroy an endless fleet of attacking ships, with an automatic tracking computer helping in the regular mode.
descriptions.c64:150275: A land war simulation of the British and Argentine forces on East Falkland between 21 May and 15 June 1982, played on a map of the island's northern part.
descriptions.c64:150277: Defend the crumbling Roman Empire from barbarian and rival armies across its provinces in Europe, North Africa and the Middle East over 12 turns of five years each.
descriptions.c64:150278: A side-scrolling Double Dragon-style brawler: starting in the London Underground, track down a drug ring's leader, finding a plane ticket and beating the local boss on each level.
descriptions.c64:150280: The TV game show with two five-person families, human or computer, playing three rounds and a timed bonus round guessing the most popular survey answers.
descriptions.c64:150330: An adventure based on Enid Blyton's Famous Five, taking the children through Aunt Fanny's cottage, a forest, a fishing boat and a courtyard on their treasure island.
descriptions.c64:150332: Children build mixed-up animals by swapping body parts, play an animal arcade game or take the creatures they made to their homes.
descriptions.c64:150334: Football for one or two players with eight teams, adjustable match length and formations, played on a top-down view of part of the pitch.
descriptions.c64:150339: Fire a cannon from the bottom of the screen at platoons of soldiers advancing from above, who creep ever closer as the battle continues.
descriptions.c64:150352: A comedy game built on the old joke of the travelling salesman and the farmer's daughter, beginning with a car breakdown near a remote farm.
descriptions.c64:150436: Captain Farragut died over a century ago, and his fortune has never reached its rightful heir; help track it down.
descriptions.c64:150439: Three-on-three full-court basketball for one or two players, with teams built from players who each have strengths and weaknesses, and quarters of 3 to 12 minutes.
descriptions.c64:150440: Run and jump between floors collecting prizes while avoiding the Sneakers who patrol each level; the tallest of them, High-Top, guards the top floor.
descriptions.c64:150445: A multiple-choice quiz for one or two players with over 4800 questions covering general knowledge, history, sports and entertainment, three difficulty levels and on-screen timers.
descriptions.c64:150480: A caped superhero flies over the city for as long as possible, dodging the rockets, balloons and helicopters filling the sky. From the Freedom Fighters collection.
descriptions.c64:150481: A boxing game where fights can go to the judges, who score bouts on clean hits and dominance, rather than always ending in a knockout.
descriptions.c64:150486: Factory worker Felix must keep his generator supplied with oil, jumping over parcels moving along conveyor belts; a touch knocks him down and carries him away.
descriptions.c64:150487: Thrown out on Christmas Eve after wrecking the family's presents, Ferris must find 25 replacements hidden around C-Zone within a time limit.
descriptions.c64:150494: Guide remote-controlled supply ferries across a scrolling asteroid field using only forward and reverse, timing each move to slip between the rocks.
descriptions.c64:150496: A very fast single-screen shooter where enemy waves loop past continually until every one has been destroyed. Published on Magic Disk 64.
descriptions.c64:150519: Overhead slot car racing with a track construction kit; bumping any of the three rivals clean off the circuit earns a two-second time bonus.
descriptions.c64:150591: Steer through rotating hazards in a one-button puzzle played in real time; clockwise and anticlockwise rotors twist the path and can sometimes be turned to advantage. Originally a VIC-20 game.
descriptions.c64:150592: Get home safely while eating food to keep strength up, killing a thief and a thug, collecting magic rings and steering clear of evil wizards; the blue tower is a place to find food.
descriptions.c64:150593: A historical WWII tactics game commanding Easy Company of the First Infantry Division through eight of its real engagements across North Africa and Europe, played alone or as a campaign.
descriptions.c64:150608: A timed logic puzzle: steer a wheel around the board to the goal flag by placing vectors and commands. Published in 64'er.
descriptions.c64:150615: A sliding tile puzzle: shift the jumbled pieces back into place to rebuild the picture.
descriptions.c64:150618: A solitaire card game in which any group of cards adding up to fifteen, such as 9 and 6 or three 5s, is discarded. Published on Loadstar.
descriptions.c64:150619: In 2140, Professor Gern B. Dick tests his new time machine from a satellite orbiting Saturn by collecting iconic objects from history, until the machine malfunctions and explodes.
descriptions.c64:150621: A naval wargame of NATO against Soviet forces in the Mediterranean for one or two players, each commanding the fleets and naval air power as theater commander.
descriptions.c64:150623: The survey ship Orion is seized by the alien Zimen just as its 20-year mapping mission ends, and four robots, Captain Slog, Plot, Knut and Able, must drive them out.
descriptions.c64:150627: Up to four hot-seat players fight for control of Thurn, a barbarian-ridden medieval island, in a pared-down take on Defender of the Crown. Each turn brings random events and income, then a choice between buying troops or marching one of your two armies into battle.
descriptions.c64:150881: Command either the RAF or the Luftwaffe in the Battle of Britain of 1940: the Germans bomb airfields, radar stations and factories while the British try to defend them.
descriptions.c64:150884: A combat flight simulator over 15,000 square miles with a full cockpit view, practice modes, blind flying, crosswinds and turbulence, covering takeoffs, landings and dogfights.
descriptions.c64:150888: A Shoot 'Em Up Construction Kit game where hostile life forms on a remote planet must be hunted down before their toxic emissions poison its atmosphere.
descriptions.c64:150891: Climb a mountain to its summit by one of several routes of differing difficulty, using alternating joystick moves and a backpack stocked with gear.
descriptions.c64:150892: Boxing with knockout competitions and a round-robin league, one-minute rounds, and fights won by wearing the opponent down until he stays down for a ten count.
descriptions.c64:150895: Drive a truck to catch supply crates dropping by parachute, dodging a bomber and a kamikaze plane, and move to the next level once enough crates are collected.
descriptions.c64:150917: A Hungarian helicopter shoot 'em up known for its soundtrack and brutally hard attack waves; the chopper's gun is upgraded on the third level, and finishing the game unlocks an ending screen.
descriptions.c64:150918: Land a small single-engine plane low on fuel, starting from 10,000 feet on the approach glide path toward the runway.
descriptions.c64:150919: A statistics-driven college basketball game where each player performs as in real life; choose lineups, substitutions, shot selection, passing and offensive and defensive styles.
descriptions.c64:150921: Pick an English club and a starting division from Fourth to First, then manage it in pursuit of the league title, the FA Cup and the League Cup.
descriptions.c64:150922: Find a way through a randomly generated labyrinth from the entrance at the top to the exit at the bottom. Supports SuperCPU machines.
descriptions.c64:150926: Third in the Magic Knight series: after rescuing Gimbal, the Magic Knight lands in the 25th century aboard the starship USS Pisces and looks for a way home, interacting through Windimation menus.
descriptions.c64:151015: Guide Fips, a hornbill from Ondulan, across a long trip over platforms in space. Published in Game On.
descriptions.c64:151016: Fire & Forget sequel: race a heavily armed car through five levels to the head of a death convoy and destroy the terrorist leader planning to blow up a city.
descriptions.c64:151056: Stop a fast-spreading forest fire on a grid map of woods, lakes and houses, choosing each turn whether to drop water or set firebreaks.
descriptions.c64:151057: Look through a submarine periscope and torpedo the enemy fleet and submarine while another player or the computer tries to sink yours at the same time.
descriptions.c64:151086: Missions run in four stages, among them rousing the firemen before they slink back to bed, driving the engine past road debris to the fire, and catching people jumping from the windows.
descriptions.c64:151087: As commander of the Firefly, fight across a grid of sectors in the enemy's mechanoid framework to reach and destroy the energy source on its far right side.
descriptions.c64:151137: Sequel to Galaxy that moves away from Galaga: slide a ship left and right to shoot formations of alien ships hovering high on the screen.
descriptions.c64:151140: In the style of the Fisher-Price toys, drive a fire truck around the neighborhood saving pets stuck in trees and people trapped in houses.
descriptions.c64:151142: As Sir Galaheart, free the land of Torot from the Evil Queen across 500 screens of streets and towns, collecting fireballs as weapons and trading heavily with townsfolk.
descriptions.c64:151143: Based on the children's TV show: drive Fireman Sam's engine around Pontypandy in a top-down flick-screen view, finding and completing jobs for the residents before returning to the station.
descriptions.c64:151145: Two tanks battle in a top-down view, each trying to blast its way into the other's fortress past guns, helicopters and infantry, with head-to-head play the main focus.
descriptions.c64:151146: Following Ugh!, the caveman tries to bring fire from the volcano to keep warm, collecting wood and carrying ladders and fire across single-screen platform stages.
descriptions.c64:151178: Command forces of the Pacific Combine or European League in futuristic ground warfare using grav tanks, striders and Leviathans with beam weapons and energy shields.
descriptions.c64:151179: Slide a ship along a horizontal line across the middle of the screen, firing up and down at approaching aliens and space debris before anything reaches the line.
descriptions.c64:151180: Track down the criminals terrorizing the country and rescue the Prime Minister's kidnapped daughter, getting her safely to the airport.
descriptions.c64:151181: The first of three Boulder Dash cave sets from Posocopi Waldkirch, with 20 new diamond-filled caves.
descriptions.c64:151182: The second Posocopi Waldkirch Boulder Dash collection, offering 20 more caves made with help from BoulderWilli.
descriptions.c64:151183: Teaches chess to children aged eight and up, explaining how each piece moves and how pieces cooperate, building up from the basic moves to simple strategy.
descriptions.c64:151184: The last of the First Boulder series from Posocopi Waldkirch, with another 20 caves of diamonds to collect.
descriptions.c64:151185: Fly with the 306th Bomb Group of B-17s from its training through the move to Thurleigh, England, and 25 missions, starting as a second lieutenant with little flight time.
descriptions.c64:151186: Train and race up to sixteen horses, earning money from wins, bets and trading, at meetings with races over one, two and three miles.
descriptions.c64:151187: The new Emperor of Kohdan has broken the alliance and is seizing the space stations deep in an asteroid field that power the Rilos System's defences.
descriptions.c64:151188: Educational games with Roger Hargreaves' Mr. Men for ages four to eight that build reading skills, including Mr. Greedy's Ice-Cream Hunt and Mr. Silly's Hat Game.
descriptions.c64:151191: Fly an F-16 through eight missions over regions such as the Middle East and Russia, picking ammunition and fuel loads before takeoff and hunting down a set number of targets in each sortie.
descriptions.c64:151203: Build Rube Goldberg-style contraptions from a limited kit of parts, placing each component so a bolt released from a wrench travels all the way into a box.
descriptions.c64:151204: A tough Boulder Dash-style puzzle game. The 1985 release was incomplete; a full edition with all 45 levels selectable and a level editor followed in 2022.
descriptions.c64:151205: Boulder Dash-style sequel built around thorny puzzles in which boulders cannot be pushed, circulated through the Digital Marketing PD and Stonysoft public-domain series.
descriptions.c64:151206: Third entry in the beer-themed Boulder Dash clone series, giving its beer-loving hero a fresh set of falling-stone puzzle levels.
descriptions.c64:151207: Suit up, board a ship and defend the home planet in a game that mixes platform sections with shooting stages.
descriptions.c64:151208: As Greybeard, grab the Pac-Men before they slip into the pipes at the foot of each level while dodging or destroying monsters, which multiply as levels advance. Published in 64'er Sonderheft 49.
