descriptions.c64:29828: Fight up the rankings against twenty computer boxers; released in Britain as Barry McGuigan World Championship Boxing.
descriptions.c64:29830: Golf follow-up to the original Leader Board and its Tournament edition with the same swing control, adding bunkers and trees and a choice of two courses for up to four players.
descriptions.c64:29831: Crawl through 13 dungeons of linked rooms to collect seven crowns and defeat the evil cleric Wistrik.
descriptions.c64:29833: In 2010 disputes are settled by Rocket Ball: five-player teams on skates from Houston, Tokyo, Moscow and Madrid battle to grab a ball fired into the arena and score.
descriptions.c64:29836: Hijack a steam train to flee Nazi-occupied territory in World War II, keeping the engine running while fighting off attacks; loosely based on the Burt Lancaster film.
descriptions.c64:29900: Real-time strategy aboard a high-tech aircraft carrier with fighters, amphibious vehicles and decoy drones, setting up resource, factory and defence bases across an island chain against an enemy carrier.
descriptions.c64:30341: Early business simulation where one to eight players compete for profit by setting production levels and prices according to basic economic principles.
descriptions.c64:30395: Command six counter-terrorists retaking an embassy: move three snipers into position around the building, then send the other three inside to clear out the terrorists.
descriptions.c64:30438: Infocom's only romance text adventure: a young noblewoman sailing to the Caribbean to reach her sick father is taken by pirates and has to find her own way through intrigue on land and sea.
descriptions.c64:31005: Search a labyrinth for five holy seals to open Pharaoh Khafka's temple gate, then enter the tomb past ghost guards, bugs and still-working traps to claim the treasure.
descriptions.c64:31006: The heir of Apshai's greatest hero searches dungeon levels for the lost Temple of Apshai, whose magic alone can save the land from turmoil.
descriptions.c64:31007: Time Master Tim must carry dinosaur eggs to the present to save them from the measles he brought to the prehistoric past, fending off spiders and snakes and the eggs' mother.
descriptions.c64:31039: The sole official follow-up to Jet Set Willy: Miner Willy explores a greatly expanded mansion, collecting items in many new platform rooms.
descriptions.c64:31422: Left by his wife, Finnish film comic Uuno Turhapuro moves to the country in this side-scrolling game, ploughing fields around rocks to earn money, water-skiing past ducks and birds, and fleeing an angry neighbour.
descriptions.c64:31448: Galactic conquest against up to three AI empires, all named by the player, on a 2D star map with no diplomacy and no control over tactical combat.
descriptions.c64:31502: Build bombers, submarines, missiles and ABM defences while spying on a hostile neighbour, until one side launches a first strike and nuclear war breaks out.
descriptions.c64:31505: Drive the MX-100 super tank across alien-held Antarctica in 2005, fighting enemy targets in 3D to destroy the invaders' main fortress.
descriptions.c64:31897: As Bond, go after drug lord Sanchez, who murdered Felix Leiter's bride, fighting on land, on the water and in the skies with helicopters, planes and tankers.
descriptions.c64:31899: Spy Hunter-style vertically scrolling driving and shooting in a gadget-equipped car, with boat sections along the way.
descriptions.c64:31903: Football management in which any league club can be chosen but always begins in the 4th division, with scouts, physios, coaches and an optional youth team to hire before the squad can progress.
descriptions.c64:31904: Take a club of your choice from the 4th division toward the top flight and cup success over an open-ended career, buying and selling players whose transfer values fluctuate.
descriptions.c64:31906: Conversion of Taito's vertical shooter: a lone biplane takes on swarms of enemy aircraft, tanks, gun emplacements and warships.
descriptions.c64:31908: Isometric maze game on ladder-linked platforms that alternates between Flip the kangaroo hopping across the tiles and Mitch the ape swinging beneath them, pursued by a zookeeper and a net; sticky squares can trap the chasers.
descriptions.c64:31909: Guide the career of a young striker at a Division 4 club toward winning Footballer of the Year, spending money on goal cards that each set up a scoring chance, up to three per match.
descriptions.c64:31910: Rather than a whole club, manage one player's career through matches and transfers, starting with ten goal cards of which up to three per match each grant a shot at goal.
descriptions.c64:31911: Third Football Manager game: take charge of a national side in the real 1990 World Cup qualifying rounds and try to win through the finals tournament.
descriptions.c64:31912: Race ten international circuits such as Monza, Monaco, Silverstone, Zandvoort and the Österreichring in wet or dry weather, with manual or automatic gears and realistic braking.
descriptions.c64:31913: Boxing in the mould of Super Punch-Out!!: as Frank Bruno, seen from just behind him, beat eight increasingly tough opponents to win the title.
descriptions.c64:31916: The son of Frankenstein's monster combs the castle for his father's scattered body parts so he can reassemble him and bring him back with 10,000 volts.
descriptions.c64:31919: Expansion for the original Gauntlet that adds 512 new dungeons and no other content.
descriptions.c64:31920: Side-scrolling football endorsed by Paul Gascoigne, with eight-direction movement and adjustable kick power, playing international sides that range in strength from Brazil to Albania.
descriptions.c64:31921: Top-down football licensed around Paul Gascoigne, with a pitch that scrolls either sideways or vertically, plus league and cup competitions, one-off matches and practice of set pieces.
descriptions.c64:31923: Conversion of Atari's coin-op adaptation of the second film: Indy cracks his whip through mine levels to free captive children, rides mine carts and raids the temple, repeating the cycle.
descriptions.c64:31954: One- or two-player wrestling from the makers of Way of the Exploding Fist, which claimed to be the earliest 3D combat sports game since fighters can move up and down the ring as well as sideways.
descriptions.c64:31956: Play the center for one of 20 unlicensed US and Canadian teams across four five-team divisions while the computer handles teammates; the top two in each division reach the playoffs.
descriptions.c64:31958: After the heroes defeat Mangar, his master the Mad God Tarjan destroys Skara Brae; the party sets out from a refugee camp on a quest to defeat him.
descriptions.c64:31960: The Archmage Lagoth Zanta has broken the Destiny Wand, protector of the realm for seven centuries, into seven pieces; a party of adventurers must recover them all.
descriptions.c64:31962: Chess opponent with 12 skill levels for novices to grandmasters, a 71,000-move opening library, printable move history, a teaching mode showing legal moves, and hints.
descriptions.c64:31963: Last entry in the Epyx Games series after Summer Games II, combining four events reworked from the earlier Summer Games titles with four brand-new ones.
descriptions.c64:31964: Follow-up to Winter Games with a new line-up of events, some returning from the original and some new, including luge, ski jumping and speed skating.
descriptions.c64:31966: Pinball on tables divided into two parts, each with its own flippers, scrolling between them as the ball moves; finishing a table requires meeting its particular objectives.
descriptions.c64:31968: Miniature golf for up to four players on four courses (Classic, Deluxe, Traditional and Challenge), with full games or practice on any hole; Classic has animated obstacles.
descriptions.c64:32000: Magneto and Arcade have abducted Professor X, and the X-Men must combine action and exploration inside the Murderworld amusement complex to rescue him.
descriptions.c64:32001: Arcade side-scrolling brawler starring Bin, a cartoon duck, who punches enemies, grabs bonus weapons and eats food for energy on the way to rescue his kidnapped friend Lucy.
descriptions.c64:32003: The demon Cerberus has abducted Elvira to steal her power; search the Black Widow Productions film studios, whose horror movie sets have come to life, to rescue her.
descriptions.c64:32005: The races of the fantasy world GHoLD meet every five years for a tournament of kicking furry Beloms at opponents; win nine matches plus two sub-games, Faulton Feeding and Revenge of the Beloms.
descriptions.c64:32006: Jimbo McGibbets returns, flying an advanced attack helicopter and then sneaking through enemy compounds to collect weapons and intelligence from huts, using gas on guards.
descriptions.c64:32007: Golf on eighteen renowned holes taken from courses in the US, Scotland and England, including Augusta National, Pebble Beach, St Andrews' Old Course, Riviera and Baltusrol.
descriptions.c64:32008: Comic mystery in which detective Hercule Holmes must crack a murder case before the crime happens, as five famous mystery writers gather at a hotel and one plans to kill another.
descriptions.c64:32009: Detective Tex Murphy investigates a professor's death in a future San Francisco, flying his speeder between locations and calling his secretary and informant for faxed information.
descriptions.c64:32010: The rogue guardian Sheltem flees through the Gates to Another World to CRON, pursued by Corak and a party of adventurers who must stop the chaos he is causing there.
descriptions.c64:32011: Cinemaware adventure styled after 1950s sci-fi serials, with cut-scenes: a rocket-pack hero flies around the globe in the 1940s to thwart a Nazi plot.
descriptions.c64:32012: The warrior Savage, freed from imprisonment in a castle, fights through three levels with distinct play styles; a code earned by finishing each grants extra lives on the next.
descriptions.c64:32013: A wizard places and removes blocks to steer a self-rolling ball to the spot marked 'In', reshaping each level's layout just to reach the ball in the first place.
descriptions.c64:32027: Charlie the clown performs five circus stunts, among them leaping through rings of fire on a lion while avoiding flaming jugs and crossing a tightrope while hopping over monkeys.
descriptions.c64:32028: Fly three scored missions in Strategic Air Command's annual bombing and navigation contest at Ellsworth Air Force Base, competing against international crews for the Curtis E. LeMay Trophy.
descriptions.c64:32029: Eight self-contained medieval contests, including crossbow shooting at rotating targets and archery at targets that slide from left to right.
descriptions.c64:32030: Former leader Kaimen has turned evil, kidnapped the Holy Ones and handed the peaceful land of Khantun to wicked monks; defeat him through exploration and martial arts combat.
descriptions.c64:32045: Chess in which captures play out as animated fights between the pieces, with the animation optional and several difficulty levels.
descriptions.c64:32046: Stone Age sports for up to six players, with dino racing, clubbing, the dino vault, saber racing, fire making and mate tossing, and six cavemen with different strengths and weaknesses.
descriptions.c64:32048: Joust-like action: tap fire to keep the Dragon Hawk flapping and swoop down on buzzards, phoenixes and dragon puppies, which can strike back the same way.
descriptions.c64:32049: Assemble a monster from 12 body types such as Tyro, Arachnid and Wasp, add enhancements like tentacles or fiery breath and weapons from rifles to flamethrowers, then send it into battle.
descriptions.c64:32050: Early music game inspired by One Thousand and One Nights: a prince steers a flying carpet over diamond gates through winding tunnels, then repeats genies' melodies to win their lamps.
descriptions.c64:32051: Bounty Bob explores an abandoned mine, recolouring every floor section by walking over it to clear each level, while working out how to reach all the sections.
descriptions.c64:32052: A blue mouse searches a labyrinth for cheese against the clock while red mice roam the maze, deadly on contact and able to surround it.
descriptions.c64:32073: Pac-Man-like maze game: collect 250 eggs laid by Queen Squirm before her workers do, avoiding her guardian worms before the lights go out.
descriptions.c64:32076: Educational maths driving game: estimate the answers to sums while racing a car seen from behind, choosing car speed and either a full race or practice.
descriptions.c64:32254: Basic training under a relentless drill sergeant, made up of four timed events that test coordination, stamina and morale.
descriptions.c64:32255: Start on a fast motorbike that can jump water and overtake enemies, then collect parts to upgrade it into a sports car and eventually a combat aircraft.
descriptions.c64:32258: Manhattan, 2019, after a nuclear war: Jungle Rogers fights through the ruined city to reach launch platform XV-238 in Professor McJerin's base and escape to the outer colonies.
descriptions.c64:32260: Dropped by helicopter, one-man army Arnie advances along a set route through an isometric, scrolling enemy complex, gunning down soldiers and destroying vehicles.
descriptions.c64:32261: An isometric shoot-'em-up sequel in which a commando blows up chemical plant valves, clears an airfield of troops, tanks and helicopters, crosses battleships in a harbor, and frees prisoners from a jungle camp, using limited grenades on foxholes.
descriptions.c64:32262: Army training simulator built around a punishing obstacle course: razor wire, water jumps, monkey bars, a log challenge, a rope swing and 12-foot walls.
descriptions.c64:32263: Riding home on his BMX after training, Phil 'Pookie' Wheeler is ambushed by the rival Diamond Backs team, whose leader wants his title of BMX Ninja.
descriptions.c64:32275: Train in karate, kendo, bo and nunchaku at a martial arts dojo, then enter the Budokan tournament to face a series of opponents.
descriptions.c64:32276: Pick from warriors ranging from monk to samurai, each with his own strengths, whose magic belt can whisk him back to base to retrain when badly wounded.
descriptions.c64:32277: One or two players learn kung fu through demanding training sessions in the Temples of Shaolin, set against a variety of oriental backdrops, before putting the skills to use in combat.
descriptions.c64:32278: Children help Donald Duck work four jobs, such as running a produce stand, to earn money for playground equipment for Huey, Dewey and Louie.
descriptions.c64:32280: One- or two-player fighting among five contenders for the Fist Fighter crown, staged in Egypt, Japan and America on a screen that scrolls slightly, with selectable location and difficulty.
descriptions.c64:32281: Martial arts follow-up from Beam Software: defend the title against ever more skilful opponents on the way to 10th Dan, with sixteen moves available.
descriptions.c64:32282: Brian Howarth text adventure based on the film: as Billy, after Gizmo has been fed past midnight, keep the gremlins from overrunning Kingston Falls with Gizmo's help.
descriptions.c64:32283: Billy sets out to rescue Gizmo from the Clamp Tower skyscraper before Dr. Catheter experiments on him, fighting through a fresh batch of vicious gremlins across five levels.
descriptions.c64:32284: Jack Burton and Wang Chi descend into Lo Pan's underground empire to save Gracie Law and Miao Yin, green-eyed women he plans to wed and sacrifice to gain a mortal body.
descriptions.c64:32285: Sequel to Ninja Rabbits: the rabbit keeps fighting to wipe out deadly nerve gases worldwide, facing Chinese dragons, Guardian Angels, crazed pandas and brawling footballers.
descriptions.c64:32286: Drive a jeep back to base through enemy territory, using speed to set jump height, front and rear guns against grenades and firebombs, and ramps onto upper platforms.
descriptions.c64:32287: Wild West action in four sections, two of shooting and two on horseback, starting with a bird shoot where the aim must lead the targets.
descriptions.c64:32288: The Black Hole Gang is out of jail and has kidnapped the Indian chief's daughter to spark a war; Marshall McGraw must stop them and save the town of Kane again.
descriptions.c64:32290: Side-scrolling Pac-Man adventure for one or two players: Pac escorts a fairy back to Fairy Land while the ghosts Blinky, Pinky, Inky, Clyde and Sue chase him.
descriptions.c64:32292: Popeye is kidnapped by the universe-conquering KRAGGS and must represent Earth in an intergalactic wrestling contest against five vicious aliens on a desolate asteroid.
descriptions.c64:32293: Percy the pigeon plucks ten nesting twigs from a busy road to build his home, dodging traffic, a pigeon-eating cat and a starving ferret.
descriptions.c64:32294: Wrestle in the ring with moves like knockout punches, body slams and flying pins, and also wheel and deal as a wrestling manager.
descriptions.c64:32295: Mickey, newly arrived in New York from the countryside, fights his way through side-scrolling streets to win gang membership by snipping a curl from the leader's hair.
descriptions.c64:32296: Skate down the road collecting Colts bottles and grabbing drinks from friendly drivers, avoiding crossing chickens and hostile cars without stopping.
descriptions.c64:32297: Five athletic events: fencing, hurdles, high diving, triple jump and a shooting contest.
descriptions.c64:32298: Isometric one-on-one fighting with high, middle and low attacks plus dodges and blocks, where harder or more effective blows score more points.
descriptions.c64:32299: Karate fighting around the world for one or two simultaneous players, against the computer or each other; originally released on the Golden Disk 64 magazine disk.
descriptions.c64:32300: Commando-style shooter in vertical flick screens: retake eight occupied townships with a rifle and five grenades, killing enemy troops and rescuing captured comrades.
descriptions.c64:32301: Follow-up to Summer Camp in which Maximus Mouse, now on rescue duty at Camp Nice'n'Icy, must stop a bird from dislodging a pebble that would bury the camp in an avalanche, over eight levels.
descriptions.c64:32302: Five winter sports: ski jumping, bobsleigh, biathlon, slalom and downhill racing; also sold under the names Winter Olympiad 88 and Winter Olympiad.
descriptions.c64:32303: Golf on three famous 18-hole courses, including St Andrews and Doral Country Club's Blue Monster, with each hole's length, bunkers, trees, rough and water hazards reproduced.
descriptions.c64:32304: Kwon, known as the Human Killing Machine, travels from country to country in one-on-one fights to prove the power of his martial arts.
descriptions.c64:32524: Sid Meier's flight simulator: fly solo across several US states, carrying mail between airports.
descriptions.c64:32527: Fast reflex puzzle based on Photon Storm's Quartet: build faces from four different sets at top speed; a refined version of a 2012 16KB cartridge competition runner-up.
descriptions.c64:32528: Official conversion of the one-button indie runner Canabalt, designed for a 16KB cartridge: a man sprints and leaps across the rooftops of a collapsing city.
descriptions.c64:32531: Horace dodges traffic on a Frogger-like road to reach the ski shop, paying ambulance fees from his $40 if hit, and then skis down a slalom course.
descriptions.c64:32539: Brothers Billy and Jimmy Lee set out to avenge Marian, gunned down by the Black Warriors' leader.
descriptions.c64:32540: Evicted by crooked attorney Tully Alford, Gomez searches the Addams mansion for the missing Morticia, Wednesday, Pugsley, Granny and Lurch.
descriptions.c64:32543: Computer version of the pencil-and-paper naval guessing game, played against a computerised opponent.
descriptions.c64:32544: Unlike the original's single screens, Hen House Harry explores a maze of linked rooms gathering cocoa, milk and sugar to build a giant chocolate egg.
descriptions.c64:32545: Separated from his hunting party by a sabre-tooth tiger ambush, a caveman makes his way home through side-scrolling terrain full of dangers.
descriptions.c64:32546: Dig tunnels and destroy Pookas and fire-breathing Fygars by pumping them up until they burst or dropping rocks on them.
descriptions.c64:32547: Billy and Jimmy Lee fight through five missions in exotic locations, armed with nunchucks, grenades, knuckle dusters and swords.
descriptions.c64:32578: Based on the film: as Ash, seen from overhead, move through the isolated cabin in the woods holding back the evil that has been unleashed.
descriptions.c64:32579: A humble knight leaves the castle to earn enough renown for a place at the Royal Court, exploring the land, talking to and helping locals, and fighting wizards, dragons and other creatures.
descriptions.c64:32580: More platform-focused sequel in which Quasimodo climbs ropes that rise and fall, rings bells and dodges hazards around the towers on his way to rescue Esmeralda.
descriptions.c64:32581: Pot-holer Pixie Pete digs his own tunnels deep underground to stay away from Desmond the Dragon, and can pump air into his pursuer with a hydraulic ram pump when it gets close.
descriptions.c64:32582: Errand boy Ronny roller-skates and shoots across town through nine levels of parkland, streets, office complexes and sewers, earning money by doing jobs for the locals.
descriptions.c64:32583: Follow-up to Sega's Shinobi: a ninja fights alongside his attack dog through side-scrolling stages to rescue the city from terrorists.
descriptions.c64:32584: Wrestle as the Ultimate Warrior, Hulk Hogan or the British Bulldog, either in practice bouts against Mr. Perfect or through a series of five matches.
descriptions.c64:32592: Drive through maze-like wilderness obstacle courses from start to finish against the clock, machine-gunning other vehicles and steering around obstacles.
descriptions.c64:32593: CJ the baby elephant breaks out of captivity and treks halfway around the world toward Africa, armed with endless peanuts and a few bombs that can be restocked along the way.
descriptions.c64:32594: Constantly upward-scrolling shooter: a mounted cowboy guards a mail train, riding along either side of it and shooting or dodging bandits and rocks.
descriptions.c64:32595: Third Dizzy adventure from the Oliver twins: Dizzy escapes the evil King's dungeon and solves item puzzles across the land on his way to rescue Daisy.
descriptions.c64:32597: Ronald Rubberduck takes on the slimy creatures of a pond with a tank of acid, using his six lives to reach and destroy the sinister Wacky Wizard lurking in the weeds.
descriptions.c64:32598: Professor Oddbod ventures into a Florida swamp poisoned by leaking nuclear waste to collect as many mutated Aisuru flowers as possible for scientists.
descriptions.c64:32599: Based on the ITV game show: race buggies, quad bikes, speedboats, jetskis and inflatables on scrolling courses over land and water, avoiding enemy droids and hazards.
descriptions.c64:32600: Formula One season over six circuits (Brazil, USA, Britain, France, Italy and Monaco), driving for Benetton against five rival drivers from teams such as Ferrari, Lotus and Brabham.
descriptions.c64:32601: Early Sid Meier combat flight game: fly a Spitfire from the cockpit in World War II dogfights against German aircraft.
descriptions.c64:32602: After the terraforming crew on an uncharted planet sends disturbing messages and then goes silent, a space adventurer explores its scrolling caverns down to the depths to rescue them.
descriptions.c64:32606: Lead an expedition up Mount Everest on a £1000 budget, hiring sherpas and buying tents, ropes, planks and rations, then establishing camps on the climb.
descriptions.c64:32607: A vertically scrolling Formula 1 racer covering a full season of qualifying laps and five-lap races; manage pit stops for fuel and repairs and spend prize money on car upgrades, with parody names standing in for real teams.
descriptions.c64:33468: Dizzy searches the storybook realm of Katmandu, hunting a leprechaun's wig, the silver lining of a cloud, a vampire duck's feather and troll brew to make a potion against the wizard Zaks.
descriptions.c64:33528: Gribbly Grobbly, a one-footed Blabgorian with psychic powers, bounces and levitates around his world to bring the young Gribblets back to safety.
descriptions.c64:33529: As Roderick Hero, descend into mineshafts to save miners trapped by volcanic activity, using a prop-pack and dynamite while avoiding creatures and lava before power runs out.
descriptions.c64:33531: Explore a vast cave for treasure with dynamite, flares, ropes and elevators, where even a short fall is fatal and a ghost drifts through the tunnels.
descriptions.c64:33598: Adventure set in Green-Sky from Zilpha Keatley Snyder's novels, where theft and violence are foreign to its people, so items cannot simply be pocketed but must be come by honestly.
descriptions.c64:33601: Unofficial successor to Seven Cities of Gold: explore Africa in search of Pharaoh Ahnk Ahnk's lost tomb, sought by the missing explorer Hiram Primm, to inherit his estate.
descriptions.c64:33602: Radium Rodney gathers radioactive seaweed from Rotaway Beach and hurls it at the Polytikian aliens who have taken the Cabinet's place at 10 Downing Street, over two screens.
descriptions.c64:33604: Early top-down dungeon crawler: a single adventurer explores deep levels and fights monsters in real time, so enemies can attack even while the character stands still.
descriptions.c64:33606: King Valwyn of Albereth has vanished after driving off barbarian invaders, and a new hero rises to defend the kingdom in an action adventure with some RPG elements.
descriptions.c64:33608: Guide a robot through 22 platform levels of ladders, treadmills, trampolines, escalators, magnets and transporters, eating every power pill as energy drains; a factory mode lets players build their own levels.
descriptions.c64:33609: Rockford, now in a spacesuit, digs through 16 new futuristic caves collecting diamonds while avoiding falling boulders and creatures.
descriptions.c64:33680: Game creation system for designing arcade-style games through joystick-driven menus, shipped on four disks with ready-made games including a tutorial game.
descriptions.c64:33681: A would-be great train robber of the Wild West punches and kicks his way past the local banker, dodges coyotes on the plains, and then battles on top of the train.
descriptions.c64:33682: A planet is on a collision course with Earth; infiltrate it, destroy each level's large energy balls to weaken its defences, and reach the portal within ten seconds once it opens.
descriptions.c64:33683: Mickey and Pluto board a spaceship and help XL30 of planet Oron recover the nine pieces of its stolen memory crystal, hidden one on each planet of the solar system.
descriptions.c64:33684: A chess program with seven strength levels, from instant replies to deep searches, a randomized opening book, a hint mode and a position editor; moves are entered as coordinates such as E2-E4.
descriptions.c64:33686: Based on James Clavell's novel: build a trading fortune in 19th-century China, acquiring a ship and crew and sailing between ports.
descriptions.c64:33722: Pitfall clone: Cuthbert runs through a brightly coloured jungle, avoiding lakes that appear and vanish, rolling logs and other hazards.
descriptions.c64:33728: Indiana Jones-style adventurer Rick crash-lands among a hostile Amazon tribe while searching for it, then braves an Egyptian pyramid and further levels full of traps.
descriptions.c64:33731: Single-screen jungle platformer: get home by working from the bottom right corner to the top left, past obstacles that grow harder along the way.
descriptions.c64:34354: Horizontal shooter with constant auto-fire, the button used only to switch weapons; convicts Rinser and Cassalana flee execution, collecting tokens to unlock later levels.
descriptions.c64:34396: The Gilbies defend the planet Iridis Alpha with robot fighters against the Zzyaxians, who are draining its energy and are willing to see it destroyed.
descriptions.c64:34703: A witch flies her broom overground to gather keys, then enters underground buildings to collect the six ingredients needed to destroy her rival, the evil pumpkin.
descriptions.c64:34705: The last surviving pumpkin bounces through the evil witch's castle to bring a lock of her hair to the cauldron, where a spell will lift the darkness from the enchanted wood.
descriptions.c64:34713: Comic, mostly menu-driven music management: assemble a band, record and release songs, tour and pull publicity stunts to make it famous.
descriptions.c64:34773: Stringfellow Hawke flies his advanced helicopter through a side-scrolling shooter against an alien invasion, picking up lasers and missiles on the way.
descriptions.c64:34878: Clumsy Colin, from the Buster comic and KP Skips ads, rides his motorbike around an isometric landscape gathering clothing and bike parts so he can enter a drag race.
descriptions.c64:34879: Drive one of five sports cars along a mountain road as fast as possible, using a radar detector or sheer speed to evade police, with a manual gearbox that blows if redlined.
descriptions.c64:34880: Work as a radar approach controller, instructing aircraft so they land safely or take off into their correct flight corridors without delays or errors.
descriptions.c64:34883: As Lio Yin, beat Wang Chen's men one-on-one on the journey from Changhun to Shanghai, using eight strikes against opponents with four lives each; a practice mode is included.
descriptions.c64:34958: Pool variant on a hexagonal table with six cushions and six pockets, where rebounds come off at odd angles; failing to pot within three shots loses the frame unless the opponent also fails.
descriptions.c64:417560: Arithmetic drill starring Snoopy in his flying-ace role: work out each math problem quickly enough or the Red Baron shoots him down. Programmed by Albert Lee from Creative Computing's original.
descriptions.c64:417992: Freddy Hardest takes on street thugs wielding bats and knives in a scrolling brawler set in a depraved future New York.
descriptions.c64:421036: Pilot a hyper-space fighter against the Bacterion invasion of Gradius, powering up with lasers, double beams and force fields.
descriptions.c64:441361: Kyle Hodgetts' public-domain version of Capcom's 1984 coin-op Vulgus, a vertically scrolling space shooter in which a lone fighter blasts endless alien waves, here accompanied by a Rob Hubbard tune.
descriptions.c64:448244: Enter the Dragon Temple as a red belt and fight a series of opponents one at a time across nine side-scrolling levels to reach 5th Dan black belt.
descriptions.c64:449056: Race a Lamborghini Diablo against rivals while evading police, betting money on races to pay for car upgrades.
descriptions.c64:451441: Atlantis's 2017 Easyflash cartridge release of the first Bard's Tale, the party-based dungeon RPG set in Skara Brae, removing the original's cumbersome multi-loading.
descriptions.c64:453853: Thomas fights his way up the floors of Mr. X's Devil's Temple, battling henchmen to rescue his kidnapped girlfriend Sylvia.
descriptions.c64:456487: Explore the 400-room tomb prepared by Drewan, last survivor of the evil Kartos empire, whose power rested on a magic amulet and four elemental runestones.
descriptions.c64:456563: Alf Yngve's second Cops shoot-'em-up, a SEUCK creation. Policemen Mike and Singh go to Greece on holiday, only for terrorists to seize several small islands and hold tourists and locals hostage, so the pair take them on alone.
descriptions.c64:457780: Two-versus-two space battle for four players, using the Protovision four-player adapter.
descriptions.c64:460862: A traditional board game played against a computer that starts by moving at random and gradually learns to make good moves more often the more it is played.
descriptions.c64:461087: A Commodore 64 take on the one-button endless runner: a man in a suit sprints across the rooftops of a collapsing city, jumping gaps and crashing through windows, with the distance covered as the score.
descriptions.c64:461251: Computer version of Hangman, ported from Alberto Sgaggero's VIC-20 original.
descriptions.c64:474136: Single-screen maze game: dig traps in the floor, wait for monsters to fall in, then fill the holes to finish them off.
descriptions.c64:474237: Sesame Street educational adventure in which children wander Big Bird's house, solving puzzles and activities that teach basic skills.
descriptions.c64:6381: Knight Arthur fights to rescue the Princess from Astaroth, the Demon King, over six levels of forest, village, mountain and cavern, each with a three-minute limit.
descriptions.c64:6383: One or two players choose from four heroes with different weapons, such as Thor the Warrior, and battle hordes of monsters through 100 levels.
descriptions.c64:6384: Gorth, the mightiest barbarian, duels eight of the sorcerer Drax's best warriors with his sword and then Drax himself to free Princess Marina from his spell.
descriptions.c64:6386: Clear all 99 sectors of the alien Restrictor Shield surrounding Earth, flying the Beamrider armed with a short-range laser lariat and a few torpedoes.
descriptions.c64:6387: Play a giant camel firing blue shots and powering up through pickups against bizarre foes such as British phone boxes, Polo mints, exploding sheep and skiing kangaroos.
descriptions.c64:6388: Bub and Bob, turned into dinosaurs, clear single-screen cave levels by trapping monsters in bubbles and popping them, with a two-player cooperative mode.
descriptions.c64:6389: Jack leaps and glides around screens set at sites like the Sphinx, the Acropolis and Neuschwanstein Castle, collecting the 24 bombs planted on each.
descriptions.c64:6391: Football with advanced control where players slow down and turn naturally rather than stopping dead, layered on top of the usual running, passing and shooting.
descriptions.c64:6392: Simple football for one or two players, with selectable shirt colours, nine computer difficulty levels and no offside rule.
descriptions.c64:6393: Frogger clone: hop across a busy street and then a river on logs and turtles, earning bonuses for lady frogs and flies.
descriptions.c64:6394: Elvin Atombender seeks revenge in this sequel; infiltrate his fortress, exploring its towers for codes while avoiding his robots.
descriptions.c64:6396: In the far future a resistance movement discovers that Macro-Genetic Mutoids are being bred purely as weapons and sets out to destroy them.
descriptions.c64:6397: Rescue five hostages from a concentration camp across six stages: setting up communications, then the jungle, a village, an ammunition depot, the camp itself and the airport.
descriptions.c64:6398: Drive a Ferrari with a passenger across a series of short routes, seen from above and behind, through sharp bends and hazards that can flip the car and cost time.
descriptions.c64:6400: Giana wakes in a strange dreamworld and fights monsters and giant spiders across 32 side-scrolling levels to find the magic diamond that will return her home.
descriptions.c64:6402: One of three heroes battles Death-Adder, who has locked up the royal family and stolen the Golden Axe, in a side-scrolling fantasy brawler.
descriptions.c64:6403: An adventurer begins beside a white house and explores the Great Underground Empire below in search of treasure in this text adventure.
descriptions.c64:6404: Horizontal shooter: a spacecraft battles swooping alien waves over a crowded landscape, collecting fuel pods to upgrade its weapons.
descriptions.c64:6405: As resistance leader Mike Donovan, plant explosives at key points aboard the Visitors' huge mothership to destroy its reactor, evading aliens and security robots.
descriptions.c64:6406: One-on-one martial arts duels with sixteen moves, from kicks to somersaults and roundhouses, selected by joystick direction, facing and the fire button.
descriptions.c64:6407: A ninja infiltrates a warehouse, dark tunnels and a secret command centre to steal a disk and escape, watching his energy bar and the time limit.
descriptions.c64:6408: Play poker against TV personality Samantha Fox, presented with digitised pictures.
descriptions.c64:6409: Drive an armed sports car up a vertically scrolling freeway, destroying enemy vehicles while protecting civilian traffic.
descriptions.c64:6411: Steer a bouncing wizard ball through grey landscapes, shooting enemies and collecting droplets of coloured paint to restore each level's colour.
descriptions.c64:6412: Spies Head and Heels are captured and separated on Blacktooth; they must reunite, liberate the enslaved worlds of Safari, Penitentiary, Book World and Egyptus, and defeat the Emperor.
descriptions.c64:6413: Break into Magma Ltd's computer system with no instructions, then steer a remote robot around the world to collect pieces of a secret document exposing the company.
descriptions.c64:6416: A secret agent infiltrates Professor Elvin Atombender's stronghold, dodging his robots while searching the rooms for fragments of a password needed to reach the central control room. Room layouts and puzzle pieces are reshuffled each game.
descriptions.c64:6419: Steer Pitfall Harry through a jungle maze to recover 32 treasures within 20 minutes, jumping and climbing past crocodiles, scorpions, rattlesnakes, fire, rolling logs, quicksand and pits.
descriptions.c64:6420: Run and fly through the Fantasy Zone, a vividly colored world with a checkerboard floor, blasting prehistoric beasts, Chinese dragons and alien pods with an arm-held cannon as the stage scrolls ever forward.
descriptions.c64:6421: Qualify with a timed lap at the Fuji circuit, then take a Formula One car into a race against a field of rival cars.
descriptions.c64:6422: Pick one of eight international fighters, among them Ken and the fire-breathing yoga master Dhalsim, and battle through a series of one-on-one bouts.
descriptions.c64:6423: On the abandoned man-made world of Alterra, made up of five bio-engineered habitats, a lone armored soldier fights the forces of the rogue ecosystem network MORGUL.
descriptions.c64:6424: Ride a bicycle along a suburban street delivering newspapers to subscribers while dodging motorcycles, tricycles, dogs, skateboarders, breakdancers and traffic, and foiling robbers along the way.
descriptions.c64:6425: Drive an off-road buggy over five courses, a looping offroad track plus north, east, west and south runs, finishing every leg before the timer expires and grabbing pickups on the way.
descriptions.c64:6434: Pilot the Super Ace, a P-38 Lightning lookalike, across the WWII Pacific toward Tokyo, shooting down Japanese aircraft and looping out of the way of enemy fire.
descriptions.c64:6435: Seven-a-side football with league and cup modes, plus a Diamond Deflection System that gives control over the direction, power and height of each kick.
descriptions.c64:6436: Steer a rotating ship through space with momentum-based thrust, blasting asteroids; coming to a halt means turning around and burning the engines to cancel the drift.
descriptions.c64:6439: As soldier Super Joe, fight alone deep into enemy territory armed with a machine gun and a handful of grenades, under a hail of mortar shells and bullets from rebel troops.
descriptions.c64:6440: Guide Dirk the Daring through a wizard's castle to save Princess Daphne from the dragon Singe, timing joystick moves and sword strikes to survive each animated hazard.
descriptions.c64:6442: Control the Influence Device aboard a robot-infested spaceship seen from above, clearing every deck of hostile droids by shooting them or seizing control of them through a circuit transfer game.
descriptions.c64:6443: A Phoenix-style shooter: blast waves of swooping aliens from the bottom of the screen, avoiding their shots and collisions, then assault the fortified Eagle Empire itself.
descriptions.c64:6444: Run a ghost-catching business in a haunted New York City, buying equipment, driving to haunted buildings and trapping spooks with proton packs and ghost traps.
descriptions.c64:6446: Lee Young sets out to rid China of the self-proclaimed Emperor Yie-Gah, last survivor of the Chop Suey Gang, battling through three-part levels that each end with a boss fight.
descriptions.c64:6447: Humanity abandoned its colonies after a plague in 2150; now a skimmer pilot heads to Tau Ceti III, silent since a meteor struck, to deal with the robot systems left running there.
descriptions.c64:6448: Trapped in a cave-filled other dimension after activating a strange 19th-century machine, the player pilots the Eidolon through 3D tunnels as the creatures it woke close in.
descriptions.c64:6449: Command a US Navy fleet submarine in the WWII Pacific, running patrols of up to two months out of Hawaii, Australia or New Zealand against Japanese shipping, with adjustable realism and time period.
descriptions.c64:6450: Mercenaries are secretly breeding the prized Tasty Space Griffin on a distant moon to wreck its market and grab power, and a space-faring dog is sent to round up the birds.
descriptions.c64:6477: Soldiers Ricky and Mary, alone or together, sweep eight-way scrolling alien bases to free captured comrades; once enough are rescued, the exit opens onto a boss guardian.
descriptions.c64:6478: Swipe the neighbor's mower and cut up to 16 lawns while staying clear of the flower beds; trampling them brings an irate gardener out after the machine.
descriptions.c64:6479: Dave leads a team of teenagers into the creepy Edison mansion to rescue Sandy, a missing classmate, solving puzzles with a verb-based point-and-click interface.
descriptions.c64:6481: Parachute behind enemy lines as a lone Ranger on missions such as killing an officer, destroying a bunker, knocking out a SAM site or freeing a POW, with maps and objectives generated randomly.
descriptions.c64:6482: A left-to-right scrolling shooter across 8 sectors of the Delta region, where pilots fight to salvage the valuable leftovers of an ancient war.
descriptions.c64:6483: Bruce Lee fights through a wizard's underground fortress, collecting the lanterns in each room to open the way onward while a ninja and a green sumo give chase.
descriptions.c64:6484: Move a lone ship left and right to dodge alien waves descending halfway down the screen, and shoot down as many as possible before it is destroyed.
descriptions.c64:6485: Sun-soaked West Coast events: surfing, half-pipe skateboarding, BMX, roller skating, footbag and flying disc, with judges scoring the surf runs.
descriptions.c64:6486: Fly the experimental Cybernoid fighter to win back the minerals and gems plundered by Zoggian pirates from three hidden asteroid storehouses, using lasers, missiles and special weapons.
descriptions.c64:6487: After their colony ship crash-lands on an uncharted Pacific island, the fuzzy aliens from planet Blot come under attack, and hero Clyde Radcliffe must rescue captured friends from elaborate torture devices.
descriptions.c64:6488: Commander Jameson begins docked at Lave Station holding 100 credits and a Cobra Mark III, free to trade, fight pirates and travel between star systems in open-ended wireframe 3D.
descriptions.c64:6489: Fly an AH-64A Apache attack helicopter armed with Hellfire missiles, a helmet-aimed 30mm cannon, rocket pods and air-to-air missiles across combat missions.
descriptions.c64:6490: A horizontally scrolling platformer where a synthetic life form, guided from a Xamoxian bunker, hunts four puzzle pieces per level, with flashing hawk eyes on the status panel pointing the way.
descriptions.c64:6491: Swept from feudal Japan to 20th-century New York, the Last Ninja fights through the city to face the returned Shogun again, solving object puzzles in an isometric world.
descriptions.c64:6492: Tiki the kiwi runs through each level dodging spikes and enemy fire to rescue a caged kiwi friend, firing arrows that can be upgraded to bombs, lasers or bouncing fireballs.
descriptions.c64:6494: Defend planet Choom from seven warring dictators, jetpacking across the surface and through the skies, in a mix of side-scrolling shooting and overhead combat.
descriptions.c64:6495: Climb each sinking island to the top by casting solid rainbows that serve both as bridges and as weapons against enemies.
descriptions.c64:6496: Recreate key scenes from the film in Chicago, taking down Al Capone's henchmen before finally arresting Capone himself.
descriptions.c64:6497: Eight national sports to compete in: weightlifting in Russia, slalom in France, log rolling in Canada, cliff diving in Mexico, caber toss in Scotland, bull riding in the US, barrel jumping in Germany and sumo in Japan.
descriptions.c64:6498: Race a police squad car through the streets of San Francisco, past its trams and the Golden Gate Bridge, in a national police car steeplechase championship.
descriptions.c64:6499: The rival spies are marooned on a volcanic island, racing to gather three missile parts and escape by submarine before the eruption, while avoiding quicksand and setting traps for each other.
descriptions.c64:6501: A Muay Thai fighting game: battle opponents starting from a cliff ledge above the home village and onward through the jungle to tougher bouts.
descriptions.c64:6502: Hacking into a system once again leads to saving the world: guide remote units through a guarded complex, watching security camera feeds and fooling the guards with replayed footage, to recover the Doomsday Papers.
descriptions.c64:6503: From the cockpit of an RAF Mosquito, attack trains, intercept V-1 flying bombs, sink U-boats and shoot down German bombers.
descriptions.c64:6506: Brought back from death by Zeus to save Athena, his daughter, a warrior fights undead and demons across Greek-themed levels, collecting power orbs to transform into beasts before facing Neff.
descriptions.c64:6507: On the radiation-mutated colony Terra-12, a small android battles the giant alien Governors that invaded and wiped out the human survivors.
descriptions.c64:6508: Bounce an energy ball off the Vaus paddle to break through 33 screens of bricks, catching capsules that power up the craft.
descriptions.c64:6510: A small green creature must topple eight towers that are poisoning planetary water supplies, circling up their outside walkways to the summit while the tower rotates around him.
descriptions.c64:6512: Choose one of four Viking warriors and compete in brutal barbarian games, with events including beer drinking and cat throwing.
descriptions.c64:6513: Shoot a centipede winding down through a mushroom field; hits leave mushrooms behind, and striking a middle segment splits it into two separate creatures.
descriptions.c64:6514: Fly the R-9a Arrowhead fighter in the 22nd century against the alien Bydo Empire through horizontally scrolling stages, backed by the detachable Force pod.
descriptions.c64:6515: Long after a nuclear war wiped out the old civilization, a tribal warrior seeks out the ancient Antiriad battlesuit, an armor immune to radiation and conventional weapons, to fight invaders.
descriptions.c64:6516: Oolong fights a series of martial-arts masters one-on-one to become Grand Master of Kung-Fu and honor his late father, using punches and kicks.
descriptions.c64:6520: Race a motorbike against the clock in a rear view similar to Hang-On, leaning through turns and weaving around other bikes, with three skill levels setting the time allowed.
descriptions.c64:6521: Eight Olympic events including track, swimming, diving, shooting and gymnastics, framed by an opening ceremony and medal presentations.
descriptions.c64:6522: In the newly renamed Britannia, Lord British seeks a spiritual leader: travel the land mastering the eight virtues to become the Avatar.
descriptions.c64:6523: Beginning where Zork I ended, in the Barrow, armed with a brass lantern and elvish sword, the adventurer explores more of the underground empire and contends with the senile, exiled Wizard of Frobozz.
descriptions.c64:6524: Tom-Tom the caveboy sets out to rescue his girlfriend Tanya from a monster, running across seven areas of four rounds each through forests, oceans, caves and ice palaces.
descriptions.c64:6525: All ten decathlon events over two days, from the 100 metres to the 1500 metres; missing the qualifying mark in an event costs one of three lives.
descriptions.c64:6526: Stranded on Targ after a crash landing, find a way off the planet in open-ended 3D, playing the native Palyars and invading Mechanoids against each other, with several routes to escape.
descriptions.c64:6527: Dizzy explores the fairy-tale-inspired Magicland to free six friends trapped under magic spells.
descriptions.c64:6528: Fly a Navy jet fighter in vector-graphics dogfights, defending a carrier task force from incoming bandits with guns and missiles.
descriptions.c64:6529: Roll a marble down six isometric, maze-like courses against the clock, avoiding drops and hazards.
descriptions.c64:6530: Skeletor has seized the Ilearth Stone, taken Castle Grayskull and kidnapped the Sorceress; He-Man first frees Orko from a spell by gathering ingredients, then battles Skeletor's horde.
descriptions.c64:6531: Sequel to Crazy Comets: shoot growing planets and moons before they smash into the ship, with two-player co-op and Rob Hubbard music.
descriptions.c64:6532: The runner sprints automatically through 32 futuristic courses against a time limit; steer sideways and adjust speed to dodge obstacles and grab items.
descriptions.c64:6533: A commando battles the Commissar's forces to save his kidnapped family, including a scientist grandfather forced to build a world-conquering weapon.
descriptions.c64:6534: Panama Joe explores the underground rooms of Montezuma's Aztec temple, collecting jewels and keys to unlock doors while avoiding enemies and traps.
descriptions.c64:6535: Patrol the moon in an all-terrain buggy, jumping craters and boulders while shooting bomb-dropping flying saucers, in the style of Moon Patrol.
descriptions.c64:6536: Michael Jackson sets out to rescue kidnapped children, including Katy, from the villain Mr. Big and his gang.
descriptions.c64:6537: Eat every dot in the maze while avoiding ghosts; power pellets make them edible, and bonus fruit wanders through for extra points.
descriptions.c64:6539: Three action scenes from the film, starting with a Ghostbuster lowered by cable down a sewer shaft to collect slime samples while ghosts try to cut his line, followed by a Statue of Liberty march and a showdown in the museum.
descriptions.c64:6540: Arthur returns to save Princess Prin-Prin from the demon king Lucifer, battling through ghoul-infested levels in his suit of armor.
descriptions.c64:6542: A tube shooter: circle the rim of the screen, firing inward at alien formations in a Galaga-like game with a pseudo-3D perspective.
descriptions.c64:6543: A futuristic cop alternates between driving down highways and side-scrolling building raids, gunning down thugs before time runs out.
descriptions.c64:6544: Several different action styles linked together, starting with a side-on brawler, with cutscenes from the film between levels.
descriptions.c64:6545: Pilot an attack helicopter with guns and missiles against enemy tanks and helicopters, switching between overhead and behind-the-chopper views; bosses are fought top-down.
descriptions.c64:6546: Professor Potts is flung back ten million years when terrorists bomb his lab, and must work through five time zones of five screens each in an adventure with action elements.
descriptions.c64:6547: Douglas Quaid fights through levels of thugs on his way to Mars to learn why he is being hunted, with some stages switching to different play styles.
descriptions.c64:6548: As Berk, carry out chores for the unseen Thing Upstairs, using objects around the castle and the creatures that crawl out of the trap door.
descriptions.c64:6549: Stranded on an island, Dizzy solves inventory puzzles to get hold of a boat and sail home to his friends and family.
descriptions.c64:6550: Drive a Ferrari F40 with a girlfriend in the passenger seat from New York to Los Angeles, racing the clock and a rival in a Porsche 959.
descriptions.c64:6551: Following his late father's trail, a young explorer searches Africa for the fabled elephants' graveyard.
descriptions.c64:6552: The sole survivor of the attack on the ship Avalon 1, Bren McGuire dons the Turrican suit to take revenge on the Machine.
descriptions.c64:6553: A telepathic Synthoid absorbs and creates objects to climb checkered landscapes and overthrow the Sentinel on the highest point, moving only by transferring into robot shells it builds.
descriptions.c64:6554: Ninja Joe Musashi crosses five missions to free children of the Oboro clan kidnapped by the crime syndicate Zeed, facing a boss at the end of each.
descriptions.c64:6556: Bart Simpson thwarts a Space Mutant invasion of Springfield across five levels by collecting or removing items they need for their machine, such as spray-painting purple objects.
descriptions.c64:6557: Skateboarding contest with five events: freestyle ramp, high jump, a downhill race, the brawling downhill jam and pool joust.
descriptions.c64:6559: Fly the Skyfox fighter from the cockpit, armed with shields, laser cannons, guided and heat-seeking missiles, to repel an alien invasion across 15 scenarios.
descriptions.c64:6560: In 2059, humans who fled the colony Orac are attacked again on planet Theon; fly a fighter in a vertically scrolling shooter against the alien fleet.
descriptions.c64:6561: Contestants on a violent game show fight from room to room through hordes of enemies, collecting weapons and prizes, before facing the host.
descriptions.c64:6562: Dizzy reads aloud a powerful spell from Wizard Theo's carelessly left book and must rescue his friends scattered into a magical underground realm.
descriptions.c64:6563: As the gyroscope probe GERALD, map 385 isometric screens of Hangworld with limited fuel, navigating gaps and diagonal paths.
descriptions.c64:6564: Based on the MAD magazine comic, the black and white spies race on a split screen to gather items such as the money, passport and secret plans before time runs out, booby-trapping rooms for each other.
descriptions.c64:6565: Strider Hiryu, youngest elite agent of a ninja-like organization, slashes through enemy forces with his cypher sword.
descriptions.c64:6656: A ninja wielding the sword Righteous Cloud slashes in all directions across seven stages of woods, wastelands, swamps, temples and cliffs, with shuriken among extra weapons.
descriptions.c64:6657: Jellystone Park is closing and its animals face the zoo, so Yogi Bear makes a run for it.
descriptions.c64:6658: Race a motorcycle across four continents, each a difficulty level, beating checkpoint time limits while weaving around other riders.
descriptions.c64:6659: One or two narcotics officers fight through eight stages, including a junkyard, subway and drug lab, to bring down Mr. Big's corporation.
descriptions.c64:6660: A Gauntlet-like overhead adventure: the druid fights monsters with spells across eight levels to destroy four magic skulls.
descriptions.c64:6661: A century after defeating Acamantor, the former druid Hasrinaxx returns to banish his old enemy in Gauntlet-style overhead combat.
descriptions.c64:6662: Eight more Olympic events, including cycling, rowing and fencing, for up to eight players.
descriptions.c64:6664: Play Mike, Neil, Vyvyan or Rick exploring the shared student house, picking up, breaking and fixing objects while the other housemates wander under computer control.
descriptions.c64:6665: The Deceptor switches between three forms to cross four isometric corridors and fulfill a destiny set by its elders.
descriptions.c64:6666: One-on-one karate tournament where a single clean hit scores, after which both fighters reset to their starting marks.
descriptions.c64:6667: A vertically scrolling shooter where I, Ball rescues four friends kidnapped by Terry Ball across 16 stages.
descriptions.c64:6668: Pilot a fighter through a horizontally scrolling shooter to destroy an invading mothership, facing aliens, gun turrets, missiles and end-of-level bosses.
descriptions.c64:6669: Based on William Gibson's novel: Case wakes up broke in Chiba City, finds a deck and software, upgrades brain implants and hacks databases to get back into cyberspace.
descriptions.c64:6670: Pick a teenager and enter Freddy Krueger's house and his Nightmare World to rescue friends, using special dream powers against him.
descriptions.c64:6672: Fly an X-15 space-plane from runway takeoff through six stages, first within the atmosphere and then into orbit, to destroy a terrorist space station holding America to ransom.
descriptions.c64:6673: Playing a Saxon knight, one of four to choose from, in a kingless medieval England, start with a single castle and fight the Normans for control of the land through raids, sieges and jousting tournaments, with Robin of Locksley offering aid.
descriptions.c64:6674: Ace pilot and neurosurgeon Johnny McGibbits flies a helicopter behind enemy lines to strike at the Mad Leader, bluffing enemy choppers by radio and showing forged papers to camp guards, with sleeping gas for when the bluff fails.
descriptions.c64:6675: Pitfall Harry explores Andean caverns hunting the Raj diamond and searching for niece Rhonda and her cat Quickclaw, avoiding poisonous frogs, eels, scorpions and bats.
descriptions.c64:6676: Sail as a privateer, plundering towns, capturing and sinking ships, courting governors for titles and searching for lost relatives, aiming to retire with wealth, land, rank and a wife.
descriptions.c64:6677: Formula One racing against a computer or human rival, pulling into the pits to refuel and change tires that fade from black toward white as they wear and become fragile once fully white.
descriptions.c64:6678: Lead a squad of five US soldiers through scenes from the Vietnam film, switching between them as each one can take three hits.
descriptions.c64:6679: F-1 racing with a timed qualifying lap for grid position followed by the race, now across a choice of four tracks.
descriptions.c64:6681: With his unit already wiped out, Dutch fights through the jungle against scorpions and enemy soldiers in a side-scrolling platformer before confronting the Predator.
descriptions.c64:6682: Race dune buggies on five courses of five stages each, from cities to deserts and tracks over water, choosing from 12 drivers.
descriptions.c64:6683: LA Lieutenant Mike Harrington, caught up in a war between rival drug gangs, hunts the alien Predator in a crosshair shooter in the vein of Operation Wolf.
descriptions.c64:6684: Pigs battle in an arena by throwing countdown bombs at each other, which go off on impact or when their timer reaches zero.
descriptions.c64:6685: Sequel to Operation Wolf: terrorists hijack a Paris-to-Boston airliner, land it in Kalubya and hide the hostages, and soldiers shoot their way through to bring them home.
descriptions.c64:6686: Head-to-head air combat between generic modern fighters, with arcade-style sorties to shoot down the enemy aircraft.
descriptions.c64:6687: Command six marines from a remote terminal, viewing their helmet cameras and firing their smart guns as they search a 255-room complex for the Alien Queen.
descriptions.c64:6689: DOH returns aboard the Xorg, a ship from another dimension, and the Vaus paddle must break through its walls of bricks to defeat him again.
descriptions.c64:6690: Fly an advanced tactical fighter shown from a third-person view as terrain scrolls beneath it, with a head-up display of thrust, speed, ground height, altitude and selected missiles.
descriptions.c64:6692: Marty McFly roams 1955 collecting clock icons while a fading family photograph tracks how close he is to erasing his own future.
descriptions.c64:6693: Five arcade and puzzle sections based on scenes from the film, as Marty McFly and Doc Brown journey across time to stop Biff altering the future.
descriptions.c64:6694: Four arcade scenes from the film set in 1885, with Marty McFly and Doc Brown facing Mad Dog Tannen's gang while seeking a way back to the present.
descriptions.c64:6695: A futuristic one-on-one ball sport in split-screen 3D: pilot a Rotofoil to grab a floating ball and shoot it through the opponent's goal, as Earth's first finalists in the year 3037.
descriptions.c64:6696: The barbarian returns, joined by the princess he once rescued, to hunt the wizard Drax through the tunnels of his dungeon, fighting monsters along the way; either hero can be played.
descriptions.c64:6697: Five sections based on the 1989 film, opening with platform action in the chemical plant hunting Jack Napier, followed by a Batmobile escape from the Joker.
descriptions.c64:6698: As fictional British flying ace Max Chatsworth, fly a biplane over diagonally scrolling terrain, bombing ground targets and dogfighting enemy planes.
descriptions.c64:6699: Play Jake or Elwood across five platform levels, escaping through a prison, along a river and across the city, collecting missing records and throwing crates at foes.
descriptions.c64:6701: More caves of diamond digging as Rockford, dodging tumbling boulders and the creatures of the caves, with later levels adding tougher puzzle elements.
descriptions.c64:6703: Marshal BraveStarr has nine minutes to find and rescue Shaman, captured by Tex Hex, starting in Fort Kerium where buildings can be entered.
descriptions.c64:6708: An action spin-off where Dizzy climbs from the seabed to the surface by hopping between short-lived bubbles and collecting pearls.
descriptions.c64:6712: Choose among eight rough wrestlers, each with a distinct fighting style, and grapple for the championship.
descriptions.c64:6713: A three-part commando mission to rescue POWs from a guerilla outpost, beginning with a dinghy ride up a mined river.
descriptions.c64:6715: As an undercover Chase HQ officer, drive after five criminals described in mission briefings, weaving through traffic and ramming their cars to make arrests.
descriptions.c64:6716: Chip must solve 149 tile-based puzzle levels, using keys and special shoes, to earn membership in Melinda's Bit Busters computer club.
descriptions.c64:6717: As Hen House Harry, collect a dozen eggs on each single-screen level of platforms, ladders and lifts, dodging ducks and grabbing corn to pause the timer.
descriptions.c64:6718: Caveman Chuck Rock sets out to rescue his wife Ophelia from the village oddball Gary Gritter, belly-bumping enemies and hauling boulders.
descriptions.c64:6719: The secret agents of the Mortadelo y Filemon comics search an overhead city map to find Dr. Bakterius, kidnapped by the rival agency OMA.
descriptions.c64:6720: Computer edition of the Waddington's board game supporting up to six players, using deduction to work out who killed Dr Black, in which room and with what weapon.
descriptions.c64:6721: Seven military training events, starting with a side-scrolling obstacle course; failing one forces a round of chin-ups to stay in.
descriptions.c64:6724: Roll a ball along a tiled space track against a timer, shooting enemies, slipping through yellow walls whose doors open and close, and destroying Space Harrier-style dragons at the end of some levels.
descriptions.c64:6725: Race across the US in a cross-country prestige car event, starting in a Porsche 911 Turbo and earning upgrades to a Lamborghini and a Ferrari.
descriptions.c64:6727: Demons have kidnapped the nine children of Clyde Radcliffe and his partner Bonnie, and Clyde must save them from elaborate torture contraptions.
descriptions.c64:6728: Bentley Bear gathers every gem in a series of isometric castles to escape, while wandering creatures try to stop him.
descriptions.c64:6730: Elvira, restoring her inherited Castle Killbragant as a horror attraction, has accidentally revived an evil ancestor, and a hero must explore the castle to stop the witch.
descriptions.c64:6731: A Liberty City police officer promoted to the ESWAT unit fights crime, eventually suiting up in cyber armor with thrusters, heavier weapons and better protection.
descriptions.c64:6732: Fly an F-15 through seven missions modeled on real operations in Asia and the Middle East, hitting air and ground targets with guns, missiles and bombs, with an arcade mode and three harder levels.
descriptions.c64:6735: Lieutenant Arkos turns against the evil queen Gremla, whose army of Terminators rules five planetary confederations beyond Alpha Centauri.
descriptions.c64:6736: As a servant to the British Royal Family, complete five tasks: lighting all the fires, retrieving Prince Andrew's toy boat from the bath, finding Diana a wig and Fergie some freckles, plus a mystery job for the Queen.
descriptions.c64:6737: Galaga sequel where the ship can also move up to halfway up the screen, shooting swarms of insect-like aliens that dive at it.
descriptions.c64:6738: Garfield sets out to get Arlene out of the cat pound, picking up objects and trading items with other characters from the comic.
descriptions.c64:6739: Lost in a dark forest at nightfall, an archer defends himself with bow and arrow against giant spiders and other monsters.
descriptions.c64:6741: Guide a spinning gyroscope down sloping isometric tracks full of hazards, in a game modeled on Marble Madness.
descriptions.c64:6742: Willy must tidy every room of his 60-plus-room mansion before his housekeeper lets him go to bed, avoiding spikes, razors and other hazards on routes with multiple entrances.
descriptions.c64:6743: Armakuni defends the Tibetan temples that feed his power against Shogun Kunitoki, across levels themed on Earth, Wind, Water, Fire and Void, earning Bushido by fighting honorably with matching weapons and never fleeing a duel.
descriptions.c64:6744: Golf across four 18-hole courses with sloped greens, using a power meter on the fire button and timing for hook or slice, for up to four players over four-round matches.
descriptions.c64:6745: Eight side-scrolling levels following the film, from a training mission in Gibraltar through General Koskov's defection to a final battle with an arms dealer.
descriptions.c64:6749: Dr Maybe has taken over Santa's North Pole workshop and holds its toy workers hostage; secret agent fish James Pond, now in a stretching robot suit, must free them.
descriptions.c64:6750: Race a Lotus Esprit across 32 tracks in three difficulty levels, finishing in the top 8 against 15 rivals to progress; a better finish means a further-back start next time.
descriptions.c64:6751: Assign skills to a stream of lemmings so they get past chasms, walls, water, lava and traps from the entrance to the exit, across four difficulty levels.
descriptions.c64:6753: Toddler Jack lands in the Australian jungle and makes mischief across 192 platform screens, lobbing coconuts at snakes, monkeys and birds.
descriptions.c64:6755: Mission-based platform game where RoboCop must destroy targets such as nukes or clear out enemies; falling short sends him to a first-person shooting range for training.
descriptions.c64:6756: RoboCop patrols side-scrolling streets, punching and shooting criminals and picking up their weapons, with levels following the 1987 film.
descriptions.c64:6757: Opens with an Operation Wolf-style shooting gallery, then switches to side-scrolling platform levels against Splatterpunks, Rehabs, Otomo Ninjabots, a tank and ED-209.
descriptions.c64:6759: Based on Tom Clancy's novel: command a NATO attack submarine as the Soviet Union, desperate for oil, invades Europe and NATO races to protect reinforcement convoys from the US.
descriptions.c64:6760: Equipped with a matter converter and gyro laser, Strider battles across rooftops, underground colonies, a ruined city and woodland to reach the prison ship holding Magenta's leader.
descriptions.c64:6761: Fly a jet up a vertically scrolling river to bomb enemy bridges, shooting ships, choppers, balloons and planes and passing over fuel depots to refuel.
descriptions.c64:6762: Two droids race along a long hilly road shooting out the side barriers while avoiding the resulting gaps, and can cooperate or shove each other in.
descriptions.c64:6763: Pilot a Valkyrie fighter from the cockpit through the fractal mountains of a fog-shrouded alien world, landing to pick up downed Ethercorps pilots, though some figures at the hatch are disguised aliens.
descriptions.c64:6764: As Road Runner, sprint down the road eating birdseed to keep up strength, dodging trucks, mines and falling rocks while luring Wile E. Coyote into them.
descriptions.c64:6766: The Ghostbusters fight through a haunted city, blasting ghosts, ghouls and mad monks, capturing the spooks and collecting keys.
descriptions.c64:6773: Seven levels in two parts: drive a jeep or helicopter across hostile terrain in the first four, then continue on foot as a soldier shooting enemies in the last three.
descriptions.c64:6774: Wake up in an asylum cell with a credit card in a box on the bed and try to escape the building, solving problems with found objects and meeting other inmates.
descriptions.c64:6775: Monty Mole tours Europe collecting money to buy the Greek island of Montos and retire, across flick-screen platform levels including the Pyrenees and the Eiffel Tower.
descriptions.c64:6776: A cat runs obstacle courses of rising difficulty through the city park, inner city, underground sewer and a bowling pub.
descriptions.c64:6777: Sentenced to sacrifice in the Aztec capital in 1500 AD, run an obstacle course to the temple and through it, dodging a variety of deadly obstacles.
descriptions.c64:6781: Bazooka Bill fights through five levels of soldiers and bombing choppers to rescue the kidnapped General MacArthur, mostly with his fists but also with knives, machine guns and flamethrowers.
descriptions.c64:6782: Caveman Thor rides a stone unicycle through mountains in search of the Meaning of Life, collecting clams to pay Peter's toll to reach the next mountain.
descriptions.c64:6783: A Ghosts 'n Goblins-style platformer with nine lives across three large levels, throwing daggers at monsters and facing a boss at the end of each.
descriptions.c64:6784: Bomb Jack hops between ledges in the four compass directions rather than flying freely, pushing enemies off at a cost in energy.
descriptions.c64:6785: Roll Bobby Bearing through isometric Metaplanes to find his four lost brothers and a cousin, nudging the unconscious bearings to safety before time runs out while avoiding evil Bearings.
descriptions.c64:6786: Fly a rescue helicopter behind enemy lines to carry as many as 16 hostages on each level back to safety while tanks and aircraft attack.
descriptions.c64:6787: The Cybernoid craft returns to recover cargo stolen by pirate ships in a flip-screen shooter, with weapons including sideways guns, bouncing bombs and seeker smart bombs.
descriptions.c64:6788: A 32-level horizontally scrolling shooter set in the Delta region, where the Hsiffan Khanate holds sway, with waves of enemy formations.
descriptions.c64:6911: Dan Dare flies the Anastasia to a hollowed-out asteroid from which the Mekon threatens to destroy Earth unless he is given rule over the galaxy.
descriptions.c64:6912: Aboard the Mekon's new spaceship, Dan Dare must find and disable control boxes to stop the genetically engineered SuperTreens.
descriptions.c64:6913: Based on Anne McCaffrey's novels, one to four players lead Weyrs, negotiating alliances with Lord Holders and fighting Thread from dragonback.
descriptions.c64:6916: The last member of the Time Corps travels to Ancient Greece, the Dark Ages and a space era to defeat a primeval entity summoned by a fanatical sect.
descriptions.c64:6917: Miner Willy collects the flashing items in each of 20 caverns before his air runs out, then reaches the exit portal, avoiding poisonous pansies and other enemies.
descriptions.c64:6918: Drive an armed car through 50 rallies, blasting enemy vehicles and collecting fuel; crashes cost fuel, and an empty tank ends the game.
descriptions.c64:6919: Rambo advances up the screen through six zones with a machine gun and a limited supply of explosive arrows, meeting a boss at the end.
descriptions.c64:6920: Mayor Mike Haggar and two allies fight through the streets of Metro City to rescue his daughter Jessica from the Mad Gear gang.
descriptions.c64:6921: Giant knights, one or two at once, smash buildings in a medieval Rampage clone.
descriptions.c64:6924: Four stages of alien combat, starting behind a protective shield and then losing it as enemies swoop in.
descriptions.c64:7062: Rambo infiltrates Soviet-occupied Afghanistan in three parts loosely following the film to rescue the kidnapped Colonel Trautman.
descriptions.c64:7127: With his girlfriend beamed into the future and himself thrown into prehistory, the hero brawls through scrolling stages set in eras from prehistoric to Egyptian, medieval and futuristic times.
descriptions.c64:7128: Guide Henry through the rooms of his house, each a single-screen level of deadly household objects like toothbrushes, teapots, flying toast and coffee machines, avoiding long falls.
descriptions.c64:7129: The springy Thing bounces into the Goblin's four-level underground lair to free the captured neighborhood toys, collecting nine jigsaw pieces per floor.
descriptions.c64:7130: In a void where indestructible worker cells build cities brick by brick, blast through the bricks to collect enough star cells to reach the next level.
descriptions.c64:7131: Six events taken in sequence: archery, swimming, skeet shooting, gymnastics, weightlifting and the triple jump, each needing a qualifying effort to move on.
descriptions.c64:7132: Rescue Penelope from cannibals across four repeating stages, starting with swinging between jungle vines, then swimming past crocodiles and dodging rolling boulders.
descriptions.c64:7133: Fire-breathing former circus strongman Karnov treks through nine levels hunting treasure, battling sword-wielding monks, djinn, hopping fish and skeletons riding ostriches.
descriptions.c64:7134: Back from training under a karate master to find the village burned and his bride-to-be seized by the warlord Akuma, the hero fights his way into Akuma's fortress to free her.
descriptions.c64:7191: A left-to-right shooter on a split display, an overhead view up top and a side view below, where flying nearer the screen's center increases scrolling speed.
descriptions.c64:7318: In 2066, investigate the silent research ship Prometheus, where a genetic experiment to breed hardy miners went wrong, fighting monsters, piecing together what happened and trying to save a survivor.
descriptions.c64:7320: Fly an American stealth fighter against Warsaw Pact defenses, slipping past radar and enemy fighters to hit primary and secondary targets before returning to base, with promotions up to general.
descriptions.c64:7328: Hop diagonally down a pyramid of cubes, changing each one's color on landing until the whole pyramid matches the target, while avoiding Coily the snake and bouncing balls.
descriptions.c64:7335: Roll an eyeball through a series of timed mazes, collecting keys and solving each maze's puzzles to reach the exit.
descriptions.c64:7383: Hack through five levels to save the land of Lograth, fighting flying demons, chimeras, valkyries and skeletons with axes, maces and other weapons, with a boss at each level's end.
descriptions.c64:7384: Bounce a tennis ball over a scrolling grid of tiles to gather all 16 smart bombs, avoiding sand, spikes, traps and enemies, while question-mark tiles may help or hinder.
descriptions.c64:7385: Brawl through the streets, subway and docks of Brooklyn to rescue a kidnapped girlfriend, using punches, kicks, headbutts and flying kicks across five levels.
descriptions.c64:7386: The top agent of the secret police force Rolling Thunder starts with only a handgun, working through guarded corridors and hidden passages to rescue captured agent Leila and stop a plot to rule the world.
descriptions.c64:7387: As Roy Race, track down the kidnapped Melchester Rovers squad in an adventure section, then play a charity match where the number of players recovered sets the size of the team.
descriptions.c64:7388: Rising from the grave, the warrior Rygar crosses the land of Argool with his Diskarmor shield on a chain to defeat the evil Ligar.
descriptions.c64:7389: Lee, trapped in a temple by the Triads, fights his way out across scrolling multi-level stages, jumping between floors and collecting energy balls released by defeated foes.
descriptions.c64:7519: Manage and play for Brutal Deluxe, the worst team in the violent future sport of Speedball, climbing a two-division league and competing in two cup tournaments.
descriptions.c64:7520: On an iceberg the spies hunt for a gyroscope, fuel canister and key card to escape by rocket before a blizzard hits, trapping each other with saws, dynamite plungers and ice picks.
descriptions.c64:7526: Rescue the fairies captured by the wicked queen Badh by touching them across levels of platform adventure, avoiding Venus flytraps, acid rain and dragons.
descriptions.c64:7531: Mr. Big holds the hero's brother at Big's Pig Pen across town, and every gang in the city stands in the way; start with bare fists and pick up weapons on the way.
descriptions.c64:7543: Lee Wong fights through horizontally scrolling levels with high ledges to save kidnapped village children from the villain Ryo Ken Oh, finding better weapons in magic urns.
descriptions.c64:7554: Biff and Jet race down river rapids on inner tubes, steering clear of the banks, crocodiles, logs and fishermen, with a supply of tin cans to throw.
descriptions.c64:7584: Based on two Tintin comic books, a multi-stage action game about getting Tintin and his friends to the Moon, alternating rocket flight through space with stages inside the ship tackling fires and a saboteur.
descriptions.c64:7614: The Dark Forces return after generations of peace, and a USS Freedom Forces soldier fights through large levels hunting secrets, upgrading three different weapon types.
descriptions.c64:7616: Matt Trakker drives the transforming Thunderhawk through four areas, dodging V.E.N.O.M. tanks while completing tasks in order, such as assembling a four-part security key so a scanner can lead him to a captured agent.
descriptions.c64:7618: Third MASK game: a side-scrolling shooter in which Matt Trakker battles the criminal V.E.N.O.M. organization to rescue his kidnapped son Scott.
descriptions.c64:7753: Drive a Lotus Esprit police car through a city to break up a drug ring, using the in-car map to track the baron's vehicles and waiting until the deal is done before moving in.
descriptions.c64:7755: As James Bond, foil Max Zorin's plan to wipe out Silicon Valley, chasing Mayday through Paris as she parachutes away, then heading to San Francisco City Hall and an abandoned mine.
descriptions.c64:7758: A warrior trapped in a dungeon shoots creatures roaming its maze corridors, some of which turn invisible, in a top-down arcade shooter.
descriptions.c64:7760: Tabloid writer Zak McKracken teams up with scientist Annie and Yale students Melissa and Leslie to stop the alien Caponians, hidden inside the phone company, from dumbing down humanity.
descriptions.c64:7762: The nameless adventurer is cast into a deep dungeon to face a final test, exploring and solving puzzles to prove worthy of becoming the Dungeon Master.
descriptions.c64:8092: Two jet-pack soldiers, the Nameless Ones, fly around scrolling stages blasting alien invaders, rotating an orbiting satellite gun to aim.
