descriptions.c64:local-9273c18e61: Steer a trampoline along the ground and bounce higher with the fire button to pick fruit from the treetops. A vulture perches in the branches and carries you off if you touch it, and missing the trampoline also costs a life.
descriptions.c64:local-9464c97501: Uncle Silas sleepwalks through his ramshackle house, full of cables, tacks and dynamite. Find him in the flick-screen rooms and steer him back to bed before the clock runs out, taking the hazards yourself so he never wakes.
descriptions.c64:local-9569344d8f: Vertically scrolling arcade shooter in which a US pilot flies the Sonic Boom jet through six levels of planes, tanks, trains and gun turrets. Each stage ends in a timed boss fight, and destroyed waves drop weapon upgrades.
descriptions.c64:local-95771cff02: Synapse sequel to Dimension X: fly a space jet in first person through a 10-by-5 grid of fifty sectors, wiping out Gorganitor squadrons. Radar tracks enemies outside your view while energy, time and shields steadily run down.
descriptions.c64:local-95919e449c: Isometric adventure in which Isvar is trapped inside the mysterious castle of Avars and must find a way out. Objects have their own weight and physical behaviour, limiting what can be carried together, and trolls drain energy that food and wine restore.
descriptions.c64:local-959a58fc06: James Bond runs and shoots through eight scrolling stages drawn from the film, starting with a paint-pellet SAS exercise on Gibraltar, and picks an item from Q's lab between levels, such as a bazooka or night-vision gear, one of which the next stage requires.
descriptions.c64:local-95bb9cfa2b: Breakout without a paddle: you steer an automatically bouncing ball left and right to clear blocks. Coloured blocks break only when the ball matches their colour, skulls and roaming enemies kill on contact, and there are 40 levels, two-player play and a level editor.
descriptions.c64:local-970e10267f: A Lothlorien wargame of the Battle of the Bulge, the 1944 German offensive in the Ardennes, for one player against the computer or two players; it was later reissued as Battle of the Bulge.
descriptions.c64:local-975e860570: Konami's top-down jeep shooter for one or two players. Rescue prisoners of war from enemy camps and drive them to a landing zone for airlift, using a forward-firing machine gun and grenades that can be upgraded to rockets.
descriptions.c64:local-9862124ba1: An undercover cop fights through the levels of a bank robbers' warehouse to reach and destroy its central power electrode. His machine gun overheats with heavy use, and some levels end with a plasma computer whose rotating vent must be shot.
descriptions.c64:local-98691a8c96: Aleksi Eeben's shooters Greenrunner, a Gridrunner-style blaster with two-player mode and sampled speech, and Redrunner, its sequel with 100 freer-form levels, plus the Retroskoi+ two-oscillator synth.
descriptions.c64:local-988d0ff092: Vertically scrolling commando shooter for one or two players, fighting on foot through jungle, rivers and ruins. Grenades, rocket launchers and machine guns can be picked up along the way.
descriptions.c64:local-998ad046b9: Based on the Concentration TV format: two players take turns flipping squares to find matching pairs, and every pair removed reveals more of a hidden picture to guess. Topics include animals, cities, sports and famous people, and a companion program edits the content.
descriptions.c64:local-9995cf1043: System 3 action game in the Last Ninja mould: a former soldier, framed by police, must rescue his scientist brother and niece from terrorists. Gather evidence across isometric flick-screen stages, then drive an armed car between them past traffic, bombing helicopters and police checks.
descriptions.c64:local-999656c9c7: Second Scott Adams adventure: a secret passage in a London flat leads to Pirate's Isle, where you must build a seaworthy ship, win over a pirate and his parrot, and bring two of Long John Silver's treasures back home. Played with two-word commands.
descriptions.c64:local-99ee4f8162: Illustrated text adventure with music: as a mysterious Stranger from a world of flying men and thinking machines, free the four enchanted heroes of Karn and recover the realm's treasures. Characters cannot be talked with, but they can be given orders.
descriptions.c64:local-9a4859f0ea: Plain singles tennis under standard rules: move with the joystick, press fire to toss and serve, and hold the button while pushing a direction to aim and power each swing. A flashing line marks where to stand for the serve, and you can pick shirt colours and the computer's skill.
descriptions.c64:local-9ad018d2f7: SAS crosshair shooter at an embassy held by terrorists. People pass behind the windows, and you shoot only those wearing the colour you are told belongs to the gunmen, reloading after six shots; hits earn promotion, while hitting a hostage costs a rank.
descriptions.c64:local-9b9e4a83cf: Oil business strategy for up to four companies, human or computer, buying and selling oilfields worldwide with goals from market leadership to total domination. Dirty tricks such as torching rival rigs are available, and short action scenes cover drilling, pipe-laying and firefighting.
descriptions.c64:local-9ba6b0ac1f: Vertically scrolling shooter against space pirates who have founded eight colonies. Each level is flown twice: first to destroy the reactor at its end, then again in darkness to wreck as many buildings as possible, with marked structures giving bonus points or extra lives.
descriptions.c64:local-9bc280b1c7: A first-person vector shooter: flying the Zarquon CAM III fighter, you enter the Deathscape grid, where the Sol Federation and Varg Empire settle disputes by duel, to stop the Varg mothership across ten increasingly twisted levels.
descriptions.c64:local-9be9bc57e6: Mike Singleton's Postern game: gather the eggs scattered around the pit while a growing number of snakes hunt you; once they are cleared, you can turn on the snakes, but only by eating them tail first.
descriptions.c64:local-9c5bb577df: A Psytronik action adventure: a space-suited explorer armed with a laser gun must cross a hostile alien planet to escape a grim fate.
descriptions.c64:local-9cf223aafa: Benny the Ball stands to inherit a dead woman's fortune unless Top Cat finds the rightful heir. Across an alley, Beverly Hills streets and a mansion you round up the gang, drink milk to keep your energy up and avoid sour milk, rotten apples and skateboarders.
descriptions.c64:local-9db32c0aae: Mario and Luigi clear the sewers of crabs, turtles and fighter flies by bumping the platform beneath each creature to flip it, then kicking it away. Played alone or by two at once.
descriptions.c64:local-9dc8172991: A nameless knight sets out to free a princess held by a dragon, breaking the lock on the castle gate, fending off magical guards and finally fighting the dragon itself.
descriptions.c64:local-9e1c1061db: Top-down action soccer with a ten-team league. Besides the usual passing, shooting and tackling there is a curling cross, control switches to your goalkeeper once the opposition enters the box, and the pitch colour can be changed mid-match.
descriptions.c64:local-9e8e8d12ca: Text adventure set in a supposedly haunted mansion in Transylvania belonging to Graf Von Schwarzherzen. Carrying an amulet that changes colour near black magic, you hunt for a stone said to turn lead into gold, plus the notebook that explains how to use it.
descriptions.c64:local-9f4b013ac4: Synapse's conversion of Sega's isometric arcade shooter. Fly an attack shuttle through a walled fortress, open space and back, using its ground shadow and an altimeter to judge height when slipping through gaps and force fields; shoot fuel tanks to keep flying.
descriptions.c64:local-9f50751650: Stranded on an island with scarce food and water, you pick your actions from menus turn by turn, hoping to be spotted by a passing ship or to build a raft from planks you gather, while avoiding the island's dangers.
descriptions.c64:local-a1555912cf: As Egor, Baron Frankenstein's assistant, you have thirty minutes before the great electrical storm to gather corpses and equipment for his experiment. Flick-screen platforming where touching creatures fills a fear meter, and losing a life drops whatever item you carry.
descriptions.c64:local-a19e74d454: SSI's second AD&D referee aid rolls up player and non-player characters, henchmen included, on printable character sheets, and generates treasure hoards, gems, jewelry and magic items, intelligent weapons among them.
descriptions.c64:local-a2572cd90b: England, 1149: with the king dead, you play one of four Saxon lords fighting the Normans and rival Saxons. Raise armies and seize territory, win land in jousting tournaments, batter castles with a catapult, raid enemy keeps for loot and now and then rescue a damsel.
descriptions.c64:local-a2d604c03c: Question pack for Trivial Pursuit aimed at those who grew up after the Second World War, with 1960s and 70s nostalgia. New categories include Broadcasting, Nightly News, Publishing, Stage and Screen, Life and Times, and RPM.
descriptions.c64:local-a2d8fdfac1: Four-level arcade adventure following the film: armed with his whip and fists, Indy gathers a shield, his father's diary and the Cross of Coronado on the way to the Grail. Stages cover Colorado caves, a circus train, a Zeppelin and Castle Grunwald, each with several routes.
descriptions.c64:local-a4460548ce: A rooster guards the henhouse so at least one egg survives to hatch. Peck away snakes, rats, raccoons and porcupines that climb ladders to the two rows of nests, eat feed to keep up energy, and visit the hen in the back room so she lays more eggs.
descriptions.c64:local-a46fa7a1fa: Randy Glover's platform classic: defuse every bomb on 30 distinct screens of Jupiter Headquarters, climbing girders, ladders and ropes past robots, homing bullets and falling hazards. Collecting some bombs reshapes the level, and up to four players alternate turns.
descriptions.c64:local-a58405e295: Epyx's wrestling game with a roster of eight invented grapplers, among them The Berserker, Purple Hays and Zeke Weasel, for one player against the computer or several friends taking each other on.
descriptions.c64:local-a60505fbe5: Five ancient prison ships full of mutated convicts have reached orbit and the inmates are eating through the hulls. Switch between five transforming Supertronic craft to seal the holes and kill escapees, letting idle craft recharge in solar mode.
descriptions.c64:local-a6abfb0e32: Infocom's adaptation of Douglas Adams's comedy, co-written with Steve Meretzky. Arthur Dent wakes with a hangover as his house, then the Earth, is demolished, and escapes with Ford Prefect; survival depends on careful observation, talking to people and consulting the Guide.
descriptions.c64:local-a710d11f44: A treasure hunt through an old manor in the spirit of The Hound of the Baskervilles, written in BASIC with PETSCII pictures and a two-word parser. Prowling dogs catch you if you stay in the open for too many moves.
descriptions.c64:local-a74cdf9567: Geoff Crammond's Formula 3 simulator, an early racing game with realistic handling physics. Brands Hatch and Silverstone are reproduced in detail, and the driving foreshadows his later Formula One Grand Prix.
descriptions.c64:local-a777b0c306: Windham Classics adaptation of Stevenson's novel, written in the second person and closely following the plot as Jim Hawkins. Other characters double as a hint system, answering questions about almost anything, and the parser handles pronouns and chained commands.
descriptions.c64:local-a8330d7345: Split-screen helicopter duel for one or two players set at an army flight school. Ferry supplies singly to your home pad, refuelling and rearming there, and shoot the rival chopper with a limited-ammo cannon; enough supplies become a bomb to drop on the enemy base.
descriptions.c64:local-a8914f54b6: Football management game built around the World Cup: pick one of 32 national sides, train a 20-man squad and set tactics and style of play. Matches are reported in text, with substitutions and tactical changes possible during play and at half-time.
descriptions.c64:local-a8a71ea42e: Four stages of climbing as Jack goes after the giant's treasure: up the beanstalk and a series of brick walls past worms, spiders and birds, then up the fireplace to the golden goose, and finally up the giant himself to the money bag on his table.
descriptions.c64:local-a93ce0926b: Light-gun shooting gallery made for the Magnum Light Phaser: hone your aim at a target range, on the plains against bandit cut-outs and in a saloon shoot-out. Unused ammunition earns a bonus once each stage is done.
descriptions.c64:local-a947459f4b: Light-hearted American Civil War strategy based on the Belgian comic Les Tuniques Bleues. Move Union or Confederate armies across a map of the States, then fight real-time side-view battles with infantry, cavalry and cannon, plus fort raids and train robberies.
descriptions.c64:local-a977397d10: Platformer based on the British children's TV cartoon: as Bangers you gather three kinds of fruit for your mum's pie, shooting or avoiding creatures and steering clear of dangerous flowers across several levels.
descriptions.c64:local-a9933fb5ba: Alligata's reworked follow-up to its withdrawn Commando-style shooter: a lone soldier with a gun and five grenades battles through eight enemy outposts, destroying vehicles and freeing prisoners before the firing squad gets them.
descriptions.c64:local-a9c77f9fd6: Scott Adams's first adventure, here with pictures: roam an enchanted land of forests, swamps, caves and a volcano to find thirteen treasures and store them safely. Hazards include quicksand, bees and a dragon, and commands are one or two words.
descriptions.c64:local-a9f3ad3815: Real-time space strategy in which the dictator of the Epsilon Galaxy fights alien empires for barren planets in buffer dimensions. Terraform worlds into farming, mining, energy or city planets, tax citizens, and build and equip armies and cruisers to invade.
descriptions.c64:local-aa9d41af28: Two-player strategy game on a triangular map of 15 towns joined by one-way roads. Players take turns moving any of four cars to a neighbouring town, each holding at most four cars; whoever cannot move once all four meet at the dead-end town loses.
descriptions.c64:local-ab0c6dd6d8: Adaptation of the Stallone film with level designs unique to the C64. Tough cop Cobra fights through city, countryside and factory, starting with fists and picking up knives, grenades and guns, sparing civilians and escorting model Ingrid to the exit.
descriptions.c64:local-ac31cddbbd: Two-word text adventure set in an evil castle. Cross the moat, get through the drawbridge and survive collapsing stairs, killer rats, a giant spider, a ghostly archer and a dungeon of skeletons to claim the treasure of the throne room.
descriptions.c64:local-ac32c8fed8: Go on a small 9x9 board against the computer or another person, with a short tutorial for newcomers. Difficulty is set through handicap stones placed before play begins.
descriptions.c64:local-ad03ad5ea2: Accolade card collection offering poker (draw, seven-card stud and hold'em), hearts and blackjack. Choose opponents from a cast of caricatured world leaders such as Gorbachev, Reagan and Thatcher, and play until one player holds all the money.
descriptions.c64:local-ad5b9d4726: Isometric third Gauntlet for one or two players. Choose from eight heroes, the classic four plus newcomers such as a rock man and a lizard man, and fight through the kingdoms of Capra, smashing monster generators and carrying items between areas to open the way onward.
descriptions.c64:local-ae1d029f15: Career simulation taking a golfer from amateur to world number one. Juggle a bank balance, loans and sponsors, divide practice hours among shot types, choose major or minor tournaments, hire caddies, coaches and hotels, and even bet on rivals at the bookies.
descriptions.c64:local-ae5d6dba1a: Konami's top-down jeep shooter for one or two players. Rescue prisoners of war from enemy camps and drive them to a landing zone for airlift, using a forward-firing machine gun and grenades that can be upgraded to rockets.
descriptions.c64:local-ae8e84f726: Based on the TV series about reptilian invaders: as resistance leader Mike Donovan you sneak through the Visitors' mothership, avoiding electrified robots, using teleport pads and alien security codes, and plant bombs at its key points.
descriptions.c64:local-af4500cfa4: Shaun Southern's native C128-mode edition of the Kikstart motorbike trials game. Race a friend on a split screen or a computer rider over courses of ramps, fences, tyres and other obstacles, judging speed, wheelies and hops to avoid being thrown.
descriptions.c64:local-af71aa72c2: Asteroids-style shooter: flying a Federation ship assigned to clear the space lanes, rotate, thrust and fire to sweep asteroids, alien craft and shooting stars from three sectors per planet between Pluto and Mercury, then slip through a sliding gap into the waiting Factory Ship.
descriptions.c64:local-b039cc0852: A private eye searches ten tower blocks for a millionaire's kidnapped daughter, riding lifts, direction-switching escalators and rubbish chutes while gunmen burst from doors. Bullets and lost fist-fights cost money from a $500 budget, while kills and rescues earn it back.
descriptions.c64:local-b08123b989: Two-player cricket from 1983 by Colin Doughty. Enter names for both teams, then take turns testing your batting skill against the bowler, swapping joysticks when the sides change over.
descriptions.c64:local-b0aae2c8b1: Graham Relph's exploration game whose world is said to hold four billion locations. Fly over the terrain from above until a beacon points toward one of nine missing objects, then land and continue on foot in a panoramic view, occasionally shooting robot bugs.
descriptions.c64:local-b12191f79e: SSI's second Dragonlance action game, following Heroes of the Lance and preceding Shadow Sorcerer in the Weiss and Hickman story. The heroes travel in side-scrolling view, one character at a time, each with different abilities.
descriptions.c64:local-b15767d94a: Computer version of the Bob Holness quiz show. Pick a hexagon marked with the first letter of its answer, buzz in and type a reply to claim it, aiming to link a path across the board; two players each get their own buzzer key.
descriptions.c64:local-b1c6c1a112: Version of the TV game show: guess how many of 100 polled people answered yes to a question, and your opponent calls higher or lower. Winning a question gives control of a row of cards to play High-Low, leading to a Big Bucks round where winnings are bet.
descriptions.c64:local-b1dcce0652: Turn-based space conquest for several admirals, or solo against neutral worlds. Each turn is a year: launch fleets from your home world, which builds ten ships annually, to seize other planets with their own industry; orders are typed in secret, and whoever holds the most worlds at the end wins.
descriptions.c64:local-b25dce8475: Imagine's action football for a single player or a tournament of up to eight. Each side controls only the man nearest the ball, so play is about positioning him, beating tackles and getting shots past the keeper before the clock runs out.
descriptions.c64:local-b2914e42d7: Joystick-controlled Yahtzee for several players. Each turn you roll five dice up to three times, keeping any you like, then point the hand at one of thirteen scoring boxes, from ones to sixes through straights, full house and chance.
descriptions.c64:local-b2b3850724: Ocean's conversion of the Nintendo arcade game. As Mario, climb girders and ladders, leap barrels and dodge fireballs to reach the captive Pauline at the top of Donkey Kong's construction site, using hammers to smash obstacles for a short time.
descriptions.c64:local-b2cfa95e91: An astronaut drifts through space to recover a runaway satellite, shooting or dodging asteroids and hostile spacemen, then holds the fire button to tow it back to the ship. Each new level brings faster enemies.
descriptions.c64:local-b321e18e4b: Magic Knight's second adventure: a botched spell has frozen eight people, including the wizard Gimbal, in time, and the Knight must free them. Its Windimation menus let you examine, use and give objects, and you must manage his strength as well as the rescued characters.
descriptions.c64:local-b32a25a29a: World conquest for two to four players in the spirit of Risk. Armies start scattered across a world map; reinforce territories, then attack neighbouring regions, with a brief animated battle deciding each clash, until one player holds every territory.
descriptions.c64:local-b4c5b782f5: HesWare's version of the faster, tougher Zaxxon sequel. Fly an isometric spacecraft through an asteroid fortress, a narrow tunnel full of fighters and mines, and a second fortress, then shoot three fire-breathing dragons in the mouth to complete the cycle.
descriptions.c64:local-b53eff2fd3: Fantasy role-playing quest: starting from Fel City you journey through the provinces, choosing a sword and spells such as teleport, healing and divination, and battle dragons, golems, vampire bats and other monsters while hunting for the magical Dragon's Eye.
descriptions.c64:local-b5f9c7c492: Melbourne House graphic adventure in which you enter a vampire's castle to save a young woman. Scenes are described in text and illustrated, some with animated characters, and the parser accepts several actions in one line; music plays throughout.
descriptions.c64:local-b65bb14129: On the polluted planet Tantris, a hopping heat probe called the Leg throws its Ball to soak up the heat of smog flames and feed it to three precious plants. Shoot wildlife, use chalk to shield against acid rain, and build the pass counter to reach the next jungle.
descriptions.c64:local-b6adfad9f1: Aliens are poisoning the seas and turning marine life into monsters. Pilot an advanced submarine through a constantly scrolling side-on shooter, torpedoing mutated creatures before your damage gauge fills.
descriptions.c64:local-b7fde4071f: Logic puzzle on nine numbered squares. Pressing the number of a lit square flips a fixed group of other squares, and the aim is to light every square except the centre one, number 5, by working out which presses affect which squares.
descriptions.c64:local-b8954d2acc: The Joker half of Batman: The Caped Crusader, titled A Fete Worse Than Death. Batman punches, kicks and throws batarangs at henchmen and solves item puzzles, with each location drawn as its own comic-book panel on the screen.
descriptions.c64:local-b9048d86a0: Illustrated text adventure set on an orbiting cemetery staffed by robots, whose chief Arch-mandroid has begun building weapons to attack a disarmed Earth. You are a special forces agent smuggled aboard in a coffin to stop him.
descriptions.c64:local-b9929ef651: Golf on a single 18-hole course: choose club, strength and direction while allowing for the wind, with a close-up window near the green for lining up putts. Includes a practice mode and two-player play.
descriptions.c64:local-ba3df3e1e8: The computer generates a small, medium or large maze, optionally letting you watch it being built, and you steer out of it as fast as you can using four direction keys.
descriptions.c64:local-bad84c3039: System 3 action game in the Last Ninja mould: a former soldier, framed by police, must rescue his scientist brother and niece from terrorists. Gather evidence across isometric flick-screen stages, then drive an armed car between them past traffic, bombing helicopters and police checks.
descriptions.c64:local-bba247a42c: Arena game for two, against a friend or a robot: each player catches the erratically moving ball with a suction gun and fires it at the bricks on their own side, aiming to clear them first. Getting hit by the ball knocks you down and hands over possession.
descriptions.c64:local-bc192ad4c8: Dino Dini's top-down football game where the ball runs free of the players' feet, making control a skill to master. Practise without opponents, then play an eight-team league whose players vary in pace, stamina, accuracy and aggression, under one of a dozen referees.
descriptions.c64:local-bc91d9f1e8: Fly through Star Quadrant Jupiter dodging solar flares and space debris, then dive down to passing moons to pick up stranded miners. Skim the surface past towers and alien destroyers, carry up to six miners, and lift off through accelerator rings.
descriptions.c64:local-bcaed9fcdb: Isometric shooter in the Zaxxon mould, set in 2024: a madman has seized decommissioned cruise missiles, and you remotely fly an unmanned interceptor through walled passages, shooting missiles and tanks while watching your fuel.
descriptions.c64:local-bdaf81a5e6: Newspaper-cartoon loafer Andy Capp has a week to find who stole his dole cheque and scrape up money for his wife Flo, wandering between pubs, the Job Centre and the police station, questioning locals and drinking while staying out of jail.
descriptions.c64:local-bdb29f239d: Turn-based strategy game by James D. Spain: two futuristic fighters from opposing sides square off one on one inside a maze.
descriptions.c64:local-bdd0b562ae: Conversion of the Atari arcade shooter styled after 1950s B movies. One or two heroes shoot through isometric factory levels on Planet X, freeing hostages, throwing levers to work escalators and boosting their ray guns, then steer a small ship through an obstacle run between levels.
descriptions.c64:local-be80c82d5a: Eighty mazes in which you move a small control block to deflect a constantly bouncing ball, smashing blocks or guiding it to an exit. Skulls cost lives, teleporters swap positions and some floor tiles harden into walls; holding space slows the action.
descriptions.c64:local-be89c0bd39: Agent in Moscow sent to back up a colleague caught stealing Soviet spacecraft plans from KGB headquarters. Scroll through platform levels shooting KGB men, searching doors for money, documents and keys, and riding lifts down.
descriptions.c64:local-befe60d76b: Spin-off of Carrier Command: drive a single Mauler assault tank, dropped in by stealth helicopter, through 3D missions such as a railway ambush, an escort and an attack on a hideout by a river. Choose weapons to match each briefing.
descriptions.c64:local-c06ffa34ba: Sierra's Targ-inspired shooter set on a grid of city blocks. Your craft moves and fires along the streets, stopping only at junctions, while aliens attack from the edges; ammunition is limited, so you must cross a reload marker when running low.
descriptions.c64:local-c07297de9a: Activision's 1986 Transformers game: send Autobots across a map of nine key sites to meet Decepticon raids, then switch to a first-person view to shoot the invaders down before they steal the resources they need for their ultimate weapon.
descriptions.c64:local-c08c50789e: Falling-block puzzle in three dimensions: rotate pieces on every axis to drop them into a pit seen from above and complete layers. The pit size and piece sets can be changed.
descriptions.c64:local-c09c61b54a: Polish maze game crossing Bomberman with Pac-Man: collect every star on the board while Frix monsters roam. Bombs found in the maze kill enemies and break walls, some of which need several blasts, but blowing up a star costs a life. 123 levels.
descriptions.c64:local-c1f8c76cfd: Futuristic real-time strategy: lead a corporate mining operation on an asteroid heading for a collision with a moon and meet your crystal quota before impact. Buy and program survey craft, diggers, trucks and combat robots, solar or fusion powered, and fight a rival company run by the computer or a second player.
descriptions.c64:local-c2145d452d: subLOGIC's American football game, with complete squads of invented players. Call plays from quick menus, then switch to action mode to control the players, against the computer or a friend.
descriptions.c64:local-c230d28960: Shaggy, Fred, Daphne and Velma are held in an evil genius's castle, and Scooby must rescue them. Platform and ladder brawler through four levels of ghosts, bats, skulls and Ghoulfish, with Scooby Snacks giving extra lives.
descriptions.c64:local-c29c617a60: Caveman Larry's bride-to-be, the chief's daughter, has been carried off by cannibals. Jump and crouch through flick-screen caves past creatures and arrow-firing cavemen, grabbing each screen's key to progress.
descriptions.c64:local-c3d112695c: Henrik Wening's take on Galaga: shoot formations of swooping aliens whose behaviour depends on their colour, some needing several hits, while large ships fire beams that narrow your space. Challenge stages give bonuses for kills.
descriptions.c64:local-c474165d05: Revision aid for O-level chemistry. Multiple-choice questions on atomic structure, valency, bonding and compounds are drawn at random and keep coming until you answer 0, after which your score is shown.
descriptions.c64:local-c4cbb82f48: Light-beam puzzle in the style of Deflektor: across 50 levels, rotate mirrors to steer a beam from start to finish, hitting enemies on the way. Barriers, switches and locked areas complicate the route, there is a time limit, and reflecting the beam back on itself causes overload.
descriptions.c64:local-c5a92d9e67: Table football for two players, each working eleven figures on four rods. Control one rod at a time and spin it to strike the ball; teams change ends after four goals and play on until four more are scored.
descriptions.c64:local-c6c970af8e: Contract bridge trainer built around a set of prepared deals. Pick a deal by number, follow the bidding to the contract, then play the hand yourself or watch the computer play it, with the option of showing all four hands.
descriptions.c64:local-c7ce039719: Level 9's illustrated sequel to Gnome Ranger. Ingrid Bottomlow, a gnome, sets out to protect Little Moaning, her home village, from the developer Jasper Quickbuck by talking its awkward residents into signing her petition.
descriptions.c64:local-c7ec027198: Second World War submarine simulation commanding the British T-class boat Beowolf against German and Italian shipping. A periscope view and gauges fill most of the screen, beside switchable engine room, torpedo, map, damage and log displays; missions range from sinking ships to landing agents.
descriptions.c64:local-c8de8914dd: Dana Clapp's text adventure that begins on a seaside holiday: you rent a sailboat, land on an island and explore the tunnels of a dormant volcano in search of its hidden treasure, escaping before the volcano blows.
descriptions.c64:local-c95d78dde3: Bat-and-ball duel for one or two players with paddles or joysticks. Each side defends a wall; knock a hole in your opponent's wall, then get the ball through the gap to win.
descriptions.c64:local-caa1bad0ec: Conversion of Capcom's first Street Fighter: as Ryu, fight two opponents each in Japan, the USA, England, China and Thailand, ending with Sagat. Special moves include the fireball, dragon punch and hurricane kick, with plank-breaking bonus rounds.
descriptions.c64:local-cad44e0b00: Three-reel fruit machine simulation with skill-stop holds, nudges and a gamble option on wins, plus a number feature grid and a high-score table.
descriptions.c64:local-cb7bf4a234: Infocom's first mystery: industrialist Marshall Robner lies dead in his locked library, apparently a suicide. You have twelve hours to search his Connecticut estate, gather evidence, have Sergeant Duffy run lab tests and question family and staff, who follow their own schedules.
descriptions.c64:local-cbaecca06c: Atarisoft's conversion of the Nintendo arcade game. As Mario, climb girders and ladders, leap barrels and dodge fireballs to reach the captive Pauline at the top of Donkey Kong's construction site, using hammers to smash obstacles for a short time.
descriptions.c64:local-cdafeb3275: Tactical naval wargame of Second World War surface actions in the North Atlantic. British ships such as King George V and Prince of Wales take on German raiders like Admiral Scheer, with range checks, main and secondary gunnery, ammunition limits and hit-location damage tables deciding the outcome.
descriptions.c64:local-ce346eaf94: Submarine attack game by Mark B. Heller for Susie Software. Set heading and range, dive to evade, and torpedo enemy shipping while watching your air supply; an end-of-patrol report lists time, ships sunk, shots fired and score.
descriptions.c64:local-ce456d739a: Text adventure: you come to on the ninth floor of an unfamiliar building and have to get out one storey at a time, crossing window ledges and quicksand, groping through rooms after a power failure and getting past an alligator.
descriptions.c64:local-ce798a0377: Konami's scrolling action game: escaped convicts hold the prison warden hostage, and a police officer fights through city streets, a park and a bridge to the jail. Freeing hostages earns extra weapons, including tear gas, but shooting one costs you all your arms.
descriptions.c64:local-ce93a728e4: Yacht racing on eight courses against computer opponents, steering and trimming the sail and centreboard while the boats are drawn in 3D wireframe. An overhead map traces everyone's course, and you can also race a fast motorboat or play against friends.
descriptions.c64:local-ce94da9c4d: Adaptation of the Stallone film with level designs unique to the C64. Tough cop Cobra fights through city, countryside and factory, starting with fists and picking up knives, grenades and guns, sparing civilians and escorting model Ingrid to the exit.
descriptions.c64:local-ceb756dd7a: Caveman Ugh climbs mountain paths with a single spear to steal pterodactyl eggs before the ice age. Pterry the pterodactyl drops rocks and a tyrannosaurus prowls the trails, and Ugh must put the spear down to carry an egg home.
descriptions.c64:local-cef51d0e2b: Text adventure by New Zealander Steven Darnold. Explore a castle, find the key to its hidden vault and a secret passage, beware a sorcerer who turns intruders into frogs, and gather treasure for a score out of 100.
descriptions.c64:local-cf058b2b6e: Infocom science fiction: a lowly deck-scrubbing ensign escapes his exploding Stellar Patrol ship and crash-lands on Resida, an apparently deserted planet with a vast research complex. Explore labs and transit systems, repair machinery and befriend the robot Floyd.
descriptions.c64:local-cf1f91f1b0: Early Commodore cartridge game: fight gravity with vertical and side thrusters to set a lander down on one of three platforms on Jupiter. Narrower pads multiply the score by 5 or 10 instead of 2, and each safe touchdown refuels part of the tank.
descriptions.c64:local-d07c0a280e: System 3's isometric ninja adventure. As Armakuni, sole survivor of a massacred clan, you cross the lands of Lin-Fen fighting with sword, staff and shuriken, solving item puzzles and seeking the palace of Shogun Kunitoki to reclaim the sacred scrolls.
descriptions.c64:local-d14d1a91d3: Vertically scrolling shooter against space pirates who have founded eight colonies. Each level is flown twice: first to destroy the reactor at its end, then again in darkness to wreck as many buildings as possible, with marked structures giving bonus points or extra lives.
descriptions.c64:local-d17993e96d: Rockford tunnels through caves collecting enough diamonds to open the exit, while boulders fall whenever the earth below them is dug away, crushing enemies or Rockford himself. Sixteen caves and five difficulty settings change diamond quotas and time limits.
descriptions.c64:local-d1ea2511b9: Radarsoft geography program for Europe. Identify the countries, capitals, seas, islands and mountain ranges marked on the map, look up facts about each country, or fly a helicopter in the Heligame to reach destinations against the clock.
descriptions.c64:local-d26b8914a0: Top-down maze shooter in the vein of Berzerk: recover the twelve Signs of the Zodiac from demons across 400 corridors whose walls are electrified, then face their master Jemon. You can only shoot while moving.
descriptions.c64:local-d273b9bbf9: A firefighter scales sixteen burning skyscrapers to reach a girl trapped on the top floor, spraying flames in windows and rescuing others on the way. Dodge falling objects and fireballs, and find power-ups such as a three-way spray, temporary invincibility and a speed boost.
descriptions.c64:local-d2797d9b87: Vertically scrolling shooter in which a Los Angeles police officer, backed by two reserves, walks the streets gunning down fire-bombing street gangs and rooftop gun turrets. Each intersection brings a gang showdown and a hostage taker to shoot without hitting his captive.
descriptions.c64:local-d2dfe33a72: Jack Lockerby text adventure: summoned by King Grimmold, ruler of the dwarfs, you set out to recover his fabled hammer from Valk, an evil magician who hides in an impregnable citadel. Friendly folk share vital clues if you say the king's name.
descriptions.c64:local-d2e5b39dad: Light-hearted American Civil War strategy based on the Belgian comic Les Tuniques Bleues. Move Union or Confederate armies across a map of the States, then fight real-time side-view battles with infantry, cavalry and cannon, plus fort raids and train robberies.
descriptions.c64:local-d35076e5c3: The last merchant in an eight-planet system plagued by pirates buys goods from wine merchants, jewellers and sawmills, sells them elsewhere and arms his ship. Shops keep hours, you must eat, drink and rest, and flights between planets are shown from the cockpit.
descriptions.c64:local-d36fdb4efb: A knight battles evil through a string of different challenges: a ball duel against a winged demon, a sword duel with a barbarian, a stormy flight past Storm Birds, a descent through a rock shaft and a platform trek through catacombs to destroy the Sacred Skull.
descriptions.c64:local-d474455f91: Sir-Tech space combat simulation by Paul Neurath and Edward Lerner. Commanding a Katana-class ship, you fly missions across quadrants such as Copernicus and Herculis against invading Andromedan warships: escort envoys, deliver ore quotas, defend outposts and land on planetoids.
descriptions.c64:local-d480e9b619: Text adventure inside the tomb of King Tutankhamun. Light your way with a limited supply of matches, deal with a hungry snake that can be tamed, and get past the knife-throwing goobers.
descriptions.c64:local-d53327769b: Parker Brothers' James Bond game: drive a multi-purpose vehicle that jumps and fires on land and water through horizontally scrolling missions, each loosely based on a different film, from Moonraker to For Your Eyes Only.
descriptions.c64:local-d5780a36a0: Jetpack hero races an 80-minute limit to assemble four parts of a weapon against the Alien Syndicate's leader. Fly through levels of ledges, spikes and lava, collecting extra guns and ammunition; you can fire in any direction but only shoot sideways while moving.
descriptions.c64:local-d5b49eaa06: Idea's top-down football game, a version of Dribbling featuring leading European national teams. Play single matches or a full season with three-, six- or nine-minute games, setting mentality, marking and the line-up beforehand.
descriptions.c64:local-d68ed2a70c: US Gold's release of the faster, tougher Zaxxon sequel. Fly an isometric spacecraft through an asteroid fortress, a narrow tunnel full of fighters and mines, and a second fortress, then shoot three fire-breathing dragons in the mouth to complete the cycle.
descriptions.c64:local-d6d6fd0fb4: Thomas M. Disch's text adventure: you wake in a Manhattan hotel with no memory, no money and no clothes, wanted for murder in Texas. Some 4,000 locations recreate the city and subway, shops keep real hours, and you must work, eat and sleep while unravelling your past.
descriptions.c64:local-d6f315da9f: Text adventure in which an office worker wakes in a prison cell after a strange phone call. Rebels hold a machine that can control people's minds, and since you are immune, you must break out, find the device and stop them.
descriptions.c64:local-d708256818: Dynacomp bridge program in which you play out deals as declarer from a given auction. It checks for faulty leads and reneges, scores made contracts and overtricks, and keeps statistics and a scorecard over a series of hands.
descriptions.c64:local-d7b75d956d: Platform adventure on a world with two moons: the magic one keeps an evil serpent imprisoned, but the other is about to eclipse it. Fight, jump, collect items and solve puzzles to prevent the snake's release.
descriptions.c64:local-d7bf5dbc6d: Missile Command clone: defend six bases along the ground by firing limited ammunition from a central launcher at incoming missiles. If the launcher is hit you cannot fire for the rest of the wave.
descriptions.c64:local-d8683363a3: Robots are setting your city's buildings ablaze. In each overhead building, spray flames with an extinguisher that overheats and wears out, and lay a limited number of firebreaks to slow the spread. A bonus path-building screen follows each cleared building.
descriptions.c64:local-d88f2e0bc5: SSI's turn-based simulation of First World War air combat over France and Germany, with up to twenty aircraft in a dogfight. Scenarios such as Voss's Last Fight and Bloody April take place on a three-dimensional grid of squares and altitude levels, with clouds and wind.
descriptions.c64:local-d8f492a36a: Play a dustman in this forced-perspective arcade game: carry each house's bin to the lorry, empty it and return it before the bonus timer runs out. Stay off lawns, and avoid maniac drivers, cyclists and barking dogs; three warnings and you are sacked.
descriptions.c64:local-d9489724b8: Illustrated text adventure: the Colourful King has lost his mind, and with it the secret of where the crown jewels and the Ring of Power are hidden. Gather the treasures, then find the ring to become king, using two-word commands.
descriptions.c64:local-d987cd38d2: George the gorilla, Lizzy the lizard and Ralph the werewolf, all mutated humans, punch city buildings until they crumble while police and soldiers shoot at them. Up to three can play at once, and each monster must keep eating to avoid shrinking back to human form.
descriptions.c64:local-d9f452f3c1: An isometric downhill motorbike race against the clock, dodging water, logs and parked cars on the way down. Prize money from fast finishes pays for crash repairs, and whatever is left buys upgrades for the bike.
descriptions.c64:local-d9f60b0654: Ice hockey built around a USA versus USSR matchup, with one-on-one or five-a-side play and a choice of period lengths. Wrist and slap shots, drop passes and body checks are all available, while roughing and cross-checking draw penalties.
descriptions.c64:local-da98cfd681: An unofficial take on The Jewel of the Nile in which three travellers jailed by a desert dictatorship must be reunited and given their chosen weapons, one of them an umbrella. On each later screen the trio is positioned before enemies arrive, then the player steers one while the computer handles the other two.
descriptions.c64:local-dbed3aa9f9: Memory game by Paul Jay for Commodore: study a face, then rebuild it from a selection of mouths and other features within one minute.
descriptions.c64:local-dca3e3b6fd: Jacques dashes around New York grabbing dropped banknotes while dodging muggers and tax collectors, then banks the cash or gambles it on Wall Street shares. Loans are available, but missing the two-month repayment brings a visit from the loan shark's thug.
descriptions.c64:local-dcf6674367: Breakout-style defence of Earth against invading creatures from NET Software: bounce your power dot off the force field with a deflector paddle to destroy them. The creatures speed up on later levels, large paddles shrink after level five, and two players can compete.
descriptions.c64:local-dd9fce3d6d: Avalon Hill strategy game for up to four mining families competing for mining rights across the planets of the solar system. Send ships to claim concessions, check travel times and lodge protests with Earth's mining council.
descriptions.c64:local-ddf9a3e895: Luxor the Moonprince and his companions resist Doomdark's armies across the land of Midnight, shown as panoramic first-person landscapes in eight compass directions. The war can be won by recruiting lords and defeating the Foul in battle, or by sending young Morkin alone to destroy the Ice Crown.
descriptions.c64:local-de0dafd16d: Barnabee the bee searches a maze-like ant nest for his kidnapped cousin Boris, steering clear of energy-sapping ants and touching flowers to recover strength and open blocked passages. Once found, the slow-moving Boris has to be escorted back up to the surface.
descriptions.c64:local-de165e82d0: A caveman runs a pedal-powered helicopter taxi, ferrying passengers between cave entrances across 69 platform levels. Lift comes only from pedalling, hitting walls too hard ends the attempt, and a swooping pterodactyl and a charging triceratops get in the way.
descriptions.c64:local-de1993de60: Each of 30 single-screen platform levels has an exit that opens only after every torch has been lit, all within a time limit. Enemies patrol set routes or chase the player, so later stages demand careful route planning to avoid dead ends.
descriptions.c64:local-deb8dd7022: Humphrey must recover a princess's gems from aliens or lose his head, grabbing every gem on each of 30 single screens before an earthquake hits. Skull blocks can be pushed to turn them into bombs that clear walls and aliens, and teleports, switches and clocks help along the way.
descriptions.c64:local-df4482f3ae: Seen from above, trains leave stations bound for set destinations, and the player flips junction points with a cursor to route a quota of them home in time. Wrongly set points halt a train, the wrong station sends it back, and collisions cost a penalty.
descriptions.c64:local-e0e5606c9b: A strategy game of the 1942 Pacific battle, commanding the American carrier task forces built around Enterprise, Hornet and Yorktown against the Japanese fleet. When Midway or the ships come under air attack, the player mans an anti-aircraft gun and shoots down the incoming planes.
descriptions.c64:local-e103334d26: Epyx's Olympic-style sports collection for up to eight players, each representing a country. Compete for gold, silver and bronze in sprinting, pole vault, platform diving, gymnastics, swimming races and skeet shooting, either as a full medal contest, a few chosen events or practice.
descriptions.c64:local-e13aabbc7f: Mr. Do the clown hammers blocks out of castle floors, dropping them on pursuing unicorns or clearing every cherry block to finish a level. Three key blocks unlock a rooftop door that turns unicorns into letters for spelling EXTRA, and knocking out two skull blocks builds a bridge between them.
descriptions.c64:local-e265f1573b: Casino keno from Comp-U-Soft: choose 1 to 15 numbers and a stake, then the computer draws 20; the more of your numbers it picks, the bigger the payout, and an odds table shows what each pick can win.
descriptions.c64:local-e2c0345f26: European release of Imagine's conversion of Nichibutsu's Galivan. The last Cosmo Police officer runs and jumps through caves, ornate halls and flooded zones on planet Cynep, starting out with only punches and kicks until a POW item clads him in a laser-armed robot suit.
descriptions.c64:local-e2c9bbff14: Casino dice game with a rules tutorial. Place pass and don't-pass line bets, come bets or wagers on single numbers, then roll the dice as the shooter.
descriptions.c64:local-e383d95885: Mario and Luigi clear crabs, turtles and fighter flies out of the sewer pipes by bumping the platform beneath them and then kicking them away. Two players can play together, racing to collect the required number of coins first.
descriptions.c64:local-e3ad551d94: A jet airliner simulator: take off, clear the surrounding mountains and land on a valley runway with fuel for only one try. Six skill levels raise the peaks, shorten the runway and add engine fires, crosswinds and the need for reverse thrust.
descriptions.c64:local-e3b0ba21ff: A steam locomotive chugs along constantly scrolling tracks, switching lines with the help of a map below while puffs of smoke knock down planes and airships and a cannon blasts oncoming trains. Fuel pods keep it running, and each station reached awards a flag; five flags complete a level.
descriptions.c64:local-e3dac201ad: A Breakout-style bat-and-ball game about destroying the universe's building blocks. Collecting five coloured balls of one kind, tracked by the letters G-R-A-V-Y, grants power-ups such as a magnetic bat or a laser, and cleared screens lead to a bonus round against Norties.
descriptions.c64:local-e408719e2d: Based on the Nickelodeon game show, players answer trivia questions or take the dare instead, facing toss-up and physical challenges and finally the obstacle course.
descriptions.c64:local-e55415d5d0: Sent into Moscow, the player must help agent Felix Hoover steal Soviet spacecraft blueprints from KGB headquarters and then escape, gunning down KGB men across scrolling platform levels. Searching doors turns up money, documents and keys, and elevators connect the floors.
descriptions.c64:local-e7ae24b327: A World War II naval simulation commanding a US Navy destroyer through submarine hunts, rescues, blockade runs, shore bombardments, scouting and convoy escort missions.
descriptions.c64:local-e7ca338d73: A Manta fighter skims the hulls of giant Super Dreadnoughts, strafing gun emplacements and enemy waves until it can land and shut down each ship's reactor. The craft scrolls left or right at speed and can roll sideways through narrow gaps, with a bonus round between levels.
descriptions.c64:local-e89eaa13e9: Part of Brian Howarth's Mysterious Adventures, this text adventure begins when a stranded motorist wanders into a circus that falls silent the moment he enters. Short typed commands are used to explore the big top, wagons and animal pens and to solve puzzles involving the trapeze, tightrope and human cannonball.
descriptions.c64:local-e8ad504eb5: Horizontally scrolling shooter over a desert landscape by Steve Lee. Your jet fighter must down a quota of enemy helicopters to clear each level, landing on a pad to take on more fuel and ammunition.
descriptions.c64:local-e8b2403845: An Asteroids-style shooter in which a Federation clearance ship sweeps asteroids, alien craft and shooting stars from the space lanes between Mercury and Pluto. After three sectors per planet, the pilot must slip through a moving gap in the Factory Ship to dock.
descriptions.c64:local-e8ef942c14: Cliff Hanger, a cartoon cowboy, tries to flatten the outlaw El Bandito using contraptions such as boulders, anvils, bombs and cannons, in the spirit of the Road Runner cartoons. Bonus points go to working out each scene's trick at the first attempt.
descriptions.c64:local-e969903401: Based on the Schwarzenegger film, Soviet detective Ivan Danko fights through four side-scrolling levels in pursuit of drug lord Viktor Rosta, punching and kicking his way past members of the Cleanheads gang.
descriptions.c64:local-e9ed4fd672: Up to eight players take turns riding stages of the famous cycling race against the clock, with no computer riders on the road. Practice and competition modes cover the full course, a selection of stages or a single stage.
descriptions.c64:local-eb1d762e86: In this sequel, Alice steps through a magic mirror at home and walks a scrolling path through a strange land, touching dragons to destroy them and jumping the moving doors that would send her back to her house. Up to four players can take part, with nine skill levels.
descriptions.c64:local-ebf53e4e6b: Two cars race around a large overhead maze collecting flags, each able to drop a rock to hold up its rival. Flags award points or other effects, and play continues until all five lives have been lost.
descriptions.c64:local-ec1b7c82bc: Old West text adventure from Victory Software by Bruce Robinson and Alan Stankiewicz. Starting in Dodge City, you track down an outlaw gang and recover the stolen gold, using matches, a canoe and other finds; success earns the reward and makes you sheriff.
descriptions.c64:local-ec7cf42e62: In 1944 the player drives a Death Tank Interceptor around the enemy-held Edward Isles, recovering supply dumps while shelling or dodging enemy vehicles among trees, buildings and rivers on a multi-directional scrolling map.
descriptions.c64:local-ec93c390f3: A cadet works up to tactical commander by earning points in three vehicles: an M1A1 Abrams tank in first person, an XR311 fast attack vehicle racing through the desert, and an ADATS air defence unit. Commanders then direct forces on a map of a West German front.
descriptions.c64:local-ed5914d7a3: A text adventure about a prisoner on Devil's Island who must break out of his cell, get clear of the prison, cross the jungle and finally leave the island for the mainland.
descriptions.c64:local-ede34898f1: A text adventure that begins in a sunny field clearing; the aim is to explore the surrounding land, find the Crystal Frog and bring it back. A percentage score tracks progress, and 100% requires visiting every location and using certain objects.
descriptions.c64:local-eec0cf3b4d: Inspector Gadget searches a flick-screen circus for six disguised MAD agents. He must first find his binoculars and extending arms to spot and catch them, avoid circus creatures, and rescue the kidnapped Penny within fifteen minutes.
descriptions.c64:local-eef27b8749: As a Human Fly you climb the faces of city skyscrapers to exterminate pesky bugs. You cannot actually fly, so stay on the building, and take care: wounded bugs turn nasty.
descriptions.c64:local-eefa5c47c6: Oscar's newly bought castle turns out to be home to the demon Grell and his minions, who are after his soul. Exploring flick-screen rooms, he gathers objects to drive them out while avoiding demons whose touch drains his soul energy.
descriptions.c64:local-efb9b1af9b: As the clown Mr. Do, the player knocks loose blocks in a multi-floor castle to crush chasing unicorns, or clears every cherry block to move on. Collecting three keys opens the roof door and gives a chance to earn EXTRA letters for a bonus life.
descriptions.c64:local-f03fdd6d5c: German action game from the year 3099: alien plasma-eaters are draining the air and water of an outpost in the Beta system, so its people reactivate the old combat robot Robox. Clear each area within the time limit, picking up stronger weapons as you advance.
descriptions.c64:local-f0da836f66: An isometric prisoner-of-war escape from a German camp. The prisoner must keep up the daily routine of roll calls, meals and exercise to avoid raising the alarm while gathering items for a break-out by tunnel, fence or back door, and he follows the routine by himself when left alone.
descriptions.c64:local-f1a48c58e0: Jeff Minter's shooter in which alien invaders dropping out of hyperspace near Pluto meet the Hellgate, a defence frame whose four wall-mounted laser heads fire at everything inside. There are 20 levels, the first eight of them selectable.
descriptions.c64:local-f3299a6050: As Police Chief Brody, the player hunts the great white shark off Amity Island, shooting other sea creatures while searching the seabed for four pieces of the weapon needed to kill it, all with the mayor demanding quick and cheap results.
descriptions.c64:local-f332545160: The sequel to Transylvania sends the player with Princess Sabrina and Crown Prince Erik to recover the stolen crown, a powerful amulet, and to defeat the vampire lord Drakul. Sabrina's magic and Erik's right as heir to certain items are needed to solve puzzles in this illustrated adventure.
descriptions.c64:local-f38e41dc51: A satirical strategy game as president of the banana republic Ritimba, handling monthly demands from the army, peasants and landowners while quietly moving treasury money into a Swiss account. The goal is to escape abroad before a coup or an assassin gets there first.
descriptions.c64:local-f41f659471: A first-person crosshair shooter in which a policeman leading the Untouchables takes on the gangsters of Al Capone and Legs Diamond across nine locations. Civilians must be spared, and each scene ends when its countdown runs out with the player still alive.
descriptions.c64:local-f48d49d1af: Darrian pilots a craft that switches between a ground tank and an aircraft to fight the alien Xenites in this vertically scrolling shooter, with some sections forcing one form or the other.
descriptions.c64:local-f4cfbc2cb6: A Centipede-style shooter: a centipede winds down through a mushroom field, splitting in two each time it is hit, while the player's craft moves along the bottom of the screen with a little room to advance.
descriptions.c64:local-f4f0e3a9d6: Jane has been kidnapped by Usanga of the Wamabo, who will feed her to his panther unless Tarzan returns seven stolen gems within three days. Chimps have scattered them across a jungle of caves, swamps and quicksand, and each run-in with lions, snakes or headhunters costs precious hours.
descriptions.c64:local-f517c951be: A high-speed shooter along a chequered floating roadway, dodging barriers, blasting enemies and using jump pads, sometimes flipping over to race along the ceiling. Collected tokens buy better weapons, but each lost life takes away the best one.
descriptions.c64:local-f55bc491f2: Kidnapped by the wizard Thelric, the player must fetch him the Amulet of Immortality to win freedom. Menu-driven controls, combined overhead and side views, and four spells including a magic missile and an energy drain help against the creatures of his world.
descriptions.c64:local-f5ce1539f7: Level 9 text adventure in three parts based on Malory's Le Morte d'Arthur. Lancelot faces the Black Knight, joins the Round Table, rescues captive knights across the kingdom, and finally seeks the Holy Grail, directing companions through the parser.
descriptions.c64:local-f63f5bb50f: One of the crocodile twins Punk and Funk tries to reach his sweetheart across more than 60 levels of thin platforms, walking around edges upside down and flipping gravity instead of jumping. Each level is cleared by headbutting all of its light bulbs.
descriptions.c64:local-f796820d3f: Sega's isometric arcade climber: a safari hunter chases the ape Bongo, who set fire to his tent, across four stages while dodging thrown coconuts and other angry animals.
descriptions.c64:local-f7d56699fe: A Choplifter-style helicopter game over eight horizontally scrolling levels, winching up a quota of men before time runs out while shooting or avoiding enemies. Three smart bombs can clear the screen in an emergency.
descriptions.c64:local-f81469fb49: Three separate puzzle games of 120 levels each, all against the clock, with a password every five levels. One has the player rebuild a pattern of numbered stones whose values rise when neighbours are placed, and two others are about clearing preset stone layouts.
descriptions.c64:local-f941db0843: Ceteka's airline management game. Start with a loan from an American or English bank, buy planes such as an old army DC-3, then choose destinations and fly passengers and cargo for profit while repaying your debts.
descriptions.c64:local-f954f42497: A text-based dungeon expedition through roughly 40 burial chambers, hunting the wizard who stole a magic chalice. Rooms hold gnomes, trolls and dragons, and the adventurer starts in a random chamber and must manage resources while mapping the barrows.
descriptions.c64:local-f9f5817277: As pilot of the B-17 Impatient Virgin with the 306th Bomb Group, the player tries to survive 50 bombing missions over France and Germany, directing a ten-man crew. After each mission the crew is rated on difficulty and bombing accuracy.
descriptions.c64:local-fabf1e3146: Dylan Dog, the London nightmare detective, accepts an invitation to a mansion where the dinner wine is poisoned and some guests are killers. He explores the house fighting them with fists, his revolver or found weapons such as a sword, hunting keys against the clock in this Italian platform adventure.
descriptions.c64:local-fc04f6fa57: Galactic conquest played in turns for one to twenty players, sending fleets between up to 40 star systems in a randomly generated galaxy. Each turn represents a year, and neutral worlds must be taken from their defenders.
descriptions.c64:local-fc106729d8: The sequel to Driller, again in solid 3D: on the moon Tricuspid, the Ketars are charging the Zephyr One weapon through a network of energy collection devices. Destroying them in the right order, since linked ones regenerate, buys time before it can fire on Evath.
descriptions.c64:local-fc44f04c9d: A boxing game with eleven opponents leading to a title fight against champion Bronx Bomber, each with a signature super punch. It offers a main event, tournament, training and sparring modes, and players can build their own boxer.
descriptions.c64:local-fc597b79f8: Text adventure by Peter Iveson for Players: find the lost staff and bring it back to restore a blighted land to its former state.
descriptions.c64:local-fcc18bb61b: Aimed at children aged three to eight, FaceMaker lets them build a cartoon face by picking hair, eyes, ears, nose and mouth, program it to smile, wink or wiggle its ears, and play Follow Me, repeating ever-longer sequences of its movements.
descriptions.c64:local-fcc66ce0d9: Bumble the creature leads children aged 4 to 10 through six games that teach number lines and graphing, such as guessing a secret number from higher-or-lower clues and finding Bumble on a grid by entering coordinates.
descriptions.c64:local-fcf3f24c86: Illustrated text adventure: answering an odd ad in The Times, you enter a competition whose prize is a fine house owned by an eccentric, then follow his letter to the property and explore it.
descriptions.c64:local-fcf5e7ed38: Othello against the computer, which can offer help to beginners. Flank your opponent's pieces to take them over; play ends once the board fills up or one side is wiped out, and the most pieces wins.
descriptions.c64:local-fd3aed235f: Ken Grant's indoor football game, first from Anirog and later reissued by Mastertronic. Name two teams and play a five-a-side match at a chosen difficulty, or take penalty kicks alone or against a friend.
descriptions.c64:local-fdbdad7060: A text-only adventure: after ignoring warnings and wandering into misty woods, the player meets a witch, vanishes by putting on her hat and ends up trapped in a cellar, needing to escape and get back home.
descriptions.c64:local-fdbf30c170: Origin's martial-arts role-playing game. As a disciple of Moebius you travel the four elemental planes, Earth, Water, Air and Fire, to take back the Orb of Celestial Harmony, stolen by the evil Kaimen, with side-view hand-to-hand fights and a karma score that shifts with your deeds.
descriptions.c64:local-fdf8c357dd: Spider-Man must rescue Mary Jane from Mysterio across a film studio full of traps, stunning enemies with webs, climbing walls and solving puzzles that undo Mysterio's tricks such as altered gravity.
descriptions.c64:local-fe78fa48d2: Driving a Wild West steam engine, the player collects gold wagons for the bank, switching points, coupling trucks carrying livestock, fuel or a sheriff, and stopping for fuel and water. Mexican bandits and ghost trains are the threats, and an arcade mode is pure survival.
descriptions.c64:local-fe7d563abf: An exiled pilot is sent on a suicide mission against an enemy force in this overhead multi-directional shooter with a rotating ship, smart bombs and weapon upgrades dropped by destroyed foes.
descriptions.c64:local-fef1e9b3b9: Set in the age of steam, this business game puts the player in charge of a train, loading raw materials at supply stations and delivering them to industries that need them, with faster deliveries earning more.
descriptions.c64:local-ff0d25c7b3: Level 9's revised trilogy of illustrated text adventures: Lords of Time, where Father Time sends you through history after nine treasures; Red Moon, recovering a stolen magic crystal; and The Price of Magik, stopping the crazed magician Myglar from draining it.
descriptions.c64:local-ff303d08a5: SSI wargame from the When Superpowers Collide line, set in 1985: NATO pushes into East Germany to relieve besieged West Berlin while Soviet forces are drawn off to Poland. Command either side against the computer or another player.
descriptions.c64:local-ff4610425c: Xonox martial-arts game starring Chuck Norris, who has six minutes to get to a monastery. Keep to the scrolling path, since straying onto grass wastes time, and beat ambushing warriors one at a time with punches, kicks and blocks against their thrown shurikens.
descriptions.c64:local-ff6323f22f: A BurgerTime-style platform game: trainee accountant Charlie sneaks into the silicon chip factory at night, walking over chip parts to push them down through the levels onto the conveyor belt.
descriptions.c64:local-ffbfae6944: Namco's isometric take on Pac-Man, with large scrolling mazes and a new jump that lets Pac-Man hop over ghosts, though some of them learn to jump too. Power pellets still turn the ghosts blue and edible.
descriptions.c64:local-ffe90bd4d7: The last Magic Knight adventure sends the hero to confront his double, the Off-White Knight, across 64 screens. Actions such as examine, pick up and cast spell are chosen from menus, objects include a chicken, eggs and a disguise, and lightning bolts strike from the sky.
descriptions.c64:local-fff84309d7: Version of the TV word puzzle show for up to three players: spin the wheel, call consonants, buy vowels and solve the phrase, dodging the bankrupt spaces, with a bonus round and a champions list.
